title: Senior Engineer - AI Evaluator
job_description:
About the job

Senior AI Interaction Evaluator (Codex / Claude Code)




Contract | $100–$200/hour | 10–20 hrs/week | Start ASAP (through early May)

Check out this Loom video for more details! 




We’re looking for highly experienced software engineer (SR+) to help evaluate the quality of interactions with modern coding agents such as OpenAI Codex and Claude Code.

This is not a traditional engineering role.

You won’t be writing production code.

You’ll be evaluating something harder: whether the model thinks like a great engineer.




What This Role Actually Is

You will assess how AI coding agents behave in real-world scenarios — focusing on:

Whether the response makes sense
Whether the preamble and reasoning are useful
Whether the output reflects strong engineering judgment
Whether the interaction feels right to an experienced developer

This role is about engineering taste — not syntax correctness.




What You’ll Be Doing

Evaluate AI-generated coding interactions end-to-end
Judge whether outputs are useful, correct (at a high level), and aligned with how a strong engineer would think
Assess the quality of explanations and reasoning, not just code
Distinguish between different levels of response quality (e.g. what makes something a 2 vs 4)
Provide clear, opinionated feedback on: what worked, what didn’t, and what felt “off” or misleading
Help define what great looks like when interacting with tools like Cursor




What We Mean by “Taste”

We’re specifically looking for engineers who can answer questions like:

Does this feel like something a strong engineer would actually say?
Is this explanation helpful, or just technically correct?
Is the model guiding the user well, or just dumping output?
Would this interaction build or erode trust?

You should be comfortable making subjective but rigorous judgments.




Who You Are

Staff / Principal-level engineer (or equivalent experience)
Strong background in one of: TypeScript/JavaScript or Python
Hands-on experience using: OpenAI Codex, Claude Code, and Cursor
Deep familiarity with modern AI-assisted dev workflows
Able to evaluate code without needing to fully execute or deeply review every line
Comfortable giving direct, opinionated feedback
High bar for what “good engineering” looks like




Nice to Have

Experience with tools like Cursor or similar AI-first IDEs
Prior exposure to prompt design or evaluation workflows
Experience mentoring senior engineers or defining engineering standards




Engagement Details

Rate: $100–$200/hour
Hours: ~10–20 hours/week
Duration: Through early May (with possible extension)
Start: ASAP




Process:

Take-home evaluation exercise

A bachelor’s, master’s, or PhD in computer science, data science, computational linguistics, statistics, or a related field is ideal; shipped QA for ML/AI systems, safety/red-team experience, test automation frameworks (e.g., PyTest), and hands-on work with LLM eval tooling (e.g., OpenAI Evals, RAG evaluators, W&B) signal fit. Skills that stand out include: evaluation rubric design, adversarial testing/red-teaming, regression testing at scale, bias/fairness auditing, grounding verification, prompt and system-prompt engineering, test automation (Python/SQL), and high-signal bug reporting. Clear, metacognitive communication—“showing your work”—is essential.

We're building an AI-powered research platform for institutional investors. Our platform turns vast amounts of market, alternative, and proprietary data into actionable intelligence — powered by AI agents that depend on clean, reliable, real-time data to do their job.

We need someone to own data. Not manage a team that does data. Own it — from finding the right sources, to getting them flowing, to making sure they stay healthy at scale.

Today we ingest from hundreds of sources. That number is growing fast. The sources are diverse: real-time market feeds, regulatory filings, on-chain blockchain data, news, social sentiment, alternative datasets, and proprietary client data. Some are free APIs. Some are $10K/month enterprise contracts. Some are clients pushing their own data into our platform. Every one of them is different, and most of them will break in ways you don't expect.

Evaluate and compare data vendors across quality, reliability, coverage, cost, and terms of service

Build monitoring that tells you — before anyone else — when data is late, wrong, incomplete, or drifting
Manage data quality at scale: anomaly detection, cross-source validation, schema drift detection, gap filling
Handle both structured data (time-series, tabular) and unstructured data (documents, text, images) with appropriate extraction and storage
Track costs per source, usage per consumer, and ROI — recommend what to keep, upgrade, or cancel
Build tooling that makes adding the next data source faster than the last one
Use AI tools aggressively in your daily work — for code generation, testing, documentation, anomaly analysis, and anything else that makes you faster

**You've done this before:**


 5+ years building data pipelines that run in production, 24/7, with real SLAs

 Python as your primary language, comfortable with async programming

You Think About The Whole Picture


 You don't just connect to an API. You think about what happens when it goes down, when the schema changes, when the data is wrong, when the bill doubles
 You understand that data has a cost and a value, and not every source is worth keeping
 You've worked with data vendors commercially — contracts, pricing tiers, usage negotiations


You Use AI Daily


 AI coding tools are part of your workflow today, not something you're curious about
 You can articulate specifically how AI makes you faster and where it doesn't help
 You'd be frustrated if you couldn't use AI in your work

Experience with financial or crypto market data
Experience with streaming systems (Kafka or similar) at scale

Proven experience with Nexus (N3K/N5K/N7K/N9K) and Catalyst platforms; experience with fabric/leaf-spine architectures.
Solid troubleshooting skills for packet flows, QoS, routing policies and overlay overlays.
Experience creating HLD/LLD, performing UAT and delivering knowledge transfers.
Excellent communication and documentation skills; able to work with cross-functional teams and customers.

Familiarity with Certification Authority (CA) operations, PKI lifecycle and operational impacts on network design.
Knowledge of ISO management systems relevant to IT/IS (e.g., ISO/IEC 27001) and practical steps to maintain audit evidence.

Experience with network automation (Ansible, Python) and configuration management.
Exposure to security tooling and logging integration (Splunk, SIEM ingestion of NetFlow/logs).

Coordinate with vendors, consultants, and contractors to ensure compliance with technical requirements.

Ensure all engineering applications and improvement activities meet safety, environmental, and regulatory standards.

Participate in risk assessments, HAZOP reviews, and incident investigations.

Promote continuous improvement in safety culture through engineering solutions and automation.

Minimum 3–5 years experience in mining or mineral processing (copper & gold preferred).

Crushing & Conveying

Filtration Plants

Hands-on involvement with industrial systems, process monitoring, or reliability engineering.

Strong understanding of industrial equipment, plant processes, and operational workflows.

Skilled in using and optimizing:

CMMS (SAP, Pronto, Oracle)

SCADA / PLC / DCS visualization

Condition monitoring tools

Engineering software (AutoCAD, Power BI, Excel, etc.)

* SELECT, JOIN, GROUP BY

* Subquery / CTE

* Filtering data besar

* HPP

* Margin

* Revenue

* Settlement

* Adjustment

* Reimbursement

* Fee marketplace

* Campaign cost

* Cancel order

* Retur

* Failed delivery

* Bisa menjelaskan masalah rumit menjadi bahasa yang mudah dipahami.

2. Apakah Anda pernah melakukan pencocokan data dari dua sumber berbeda? Jelaskan contohnya.

Mobile Robots: Integrating custom payloads and companion computers onto mobile robot platforms, running ROS2-based navigation and perception stacks for wheeled and legged robots in indoor and outdoor environments.

Proficiency in C++ and Python.

Proficiency in Linux-based single-board computer integration (e.g., Raspberry Pi, Nvidia Jetson Orin Nano).

Experience with sensor integration (e.g., IMU, LiDAR, depth cameras).

Experience with robotics simulation tools (e.g., Gazebo, Isaac Sim).

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Robotics, Mechatronics, Electrical, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

At least 1 year of working experience. Fresh graduates with a strong project portfolio are also welcome to apply .




Nice-to-have

Experience in building and deploying robotic systems in real-world environments.

Hands-on skills in 3D design and 3D printing for prototyping.

Experience with building quadcopter drones and custom drone software using MAVLINK, ArduPilot, and Mission Planner.

title: ETL Testing & Automation Lead
job_description:
Role Summary

We are looking for an experienced ETL Testing & ETL Automation Lead to drive data quality assurance initiatives for large-scale enterprise data platforms. The role will lead end-to-end ETL testing activities, automation strategy, data validation governance, and coordination across data engineering, QA, business, and project stakeholders.

The ideal candidate has strong hands-on experience in ETL/Data Testing, SQL validation, automation frameworks, and large-scale data warehouse environments, combined with leadership capabilities in managing testing streams, test planning, defect governance, and delivery coordination.

Key Responsibilities

Lead end-to-end ETL testing activities for data ingestion, transformation, migration, and loading processes across multiple systems.

Define ETL testing strategy, test scope, test planning, and execution approach for large-scale data platform initiatives.

Review and validate source-to-target mappings, transformation logic, business rules, and reconciliation processes.

Drive data migration validation activities, including completeness, consistency, accuracy, and reconciliation checks.

Lead SQL-based validation activities across source, staging, and target layers.

Oversee ETL job validation, workflow testing, scheduling validation, and error-handling verification.

Design and drive ETL automation frameworks for regression, reconciliation, and sanity testing.

Coordinate with Data Engineers, Developers, Architects, Business Users, and QA teams to resolve defects and ensure data quality standards are achieved.

Monitor testing progress, defect leakage, quality metrics, and testing deliverables across the project lifecycle.

Review test cases, test execution reports, defect reports, and validation summaries before stakeholder sign-off.

Ensure adherence to QA governance, audit requirements, release processes, and enterprise data quality standards.

Support Agile / PI-based delivery execution and provide status reporting to project stakeholders and management.

Mentor junior ETL testers and support capability development within the testing team.

Experience Level

8–12 years of relevant experience in ETL / Data Testing, with at least 2–3 years in a Lead or Senior Lead capacity.

Technical Skills (Mandatory)

Strong hands-on experience in ETL / Data Testing and Data Quality Validation.

Advanced SQL proficiency, including complex joins, aggregations, reconciliation queries, and performance-aware validation.

Hands-on experience with ETL tools such as Informatica, Talend, DataStage, Ab Initio, or similar platforms.

Strong experience in Data Warehouse / Data Lake testing environments.

Experience in data migration testing and reconciliation validation for enterprise-scale systems.

Hands-on experience in ETL automation frameworks using Python, Shell Scripting, or custom automation frameworks.

Experience leading testing activities across multiple systems and integrations.

Strong understanding of defect management, root-cause analysis, and QA governance processes.

Preferred / Good-to-Have Skills

Experience with GCP, BigQuery, or cloud-based data platforms.

Exposure to API testing and integration data validation.

Prior experience in telecom or enterprise-scale data domains.

Experience working in Agile / PI-based delivery models.

Hands-on experience with JIRA or similar defect management tools.

Exposure to CI/CD and automated validation pipelines is an advantage.

Soft Skills

Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

Ability to lead cross-functional discussions and coordinate across distributed teams.

Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capability.

Able to work in fast-paced, delivery-oriented environments with multiple priorities.

Strong ownership and accountability in driving testing quality and delivery timelines.

title: Principal Product Manager - Discovery and Personalisation
job_description:
The Principal Product Manager for Discovery & Personalisation will own how subscribers find, explore and return to The Economist's journalism across web and app. This is a senior, cross-cutting role spanning two closely related disciplines:

Discovery. Owning the on-platform representation of our content - search, navigation, browse patterns and conversational interfaces that allow users to interrogate the archive and find authoritative journalism efficiently. This includes keyword and semantic search, ranking and surfacing logic, and generative AI features such as Q&A, content summarisation and conversational discovery experiences. A key part of this work is establishing the evaluation frameworks and human-in-the-loop processes that ensure AI-powered features are grounded in user trust and consistent with our editorial brand.       

Personalisation. Owning the recommendation and ranking algorithms that drive browse-led experiences — helping subscribers decide what to read, watch or listen to next. This means defining the behavioural signals and contextual inputs that feed personalisation models, partnering with data science on model development and evaluation, and ensuring our systems support habit formation without narrowing editorial perspective.

 The role interfaces with Web, App, Data science, Editorial and Analytics teams.

Responsibilities

Own the vision and roadmap for Discovery & Personalisation across web and app.

Lead the evolution of keyword and semantic search, including relevance, ranking and result quality.

Own browse-led personalisation systems — defining the signals, models and decisioning logic that surface relevant, timely content for individual subscribers.

Lead the creation of generative AI features including Q&A, content summarisation, explainer and conversational discovery experiences that help users explore and connect our journalism.

Establish robust evaluation frameworks and human-in-the-loop processes to ensure AI-powered features are accurate, transparent and aligned with our editorial values.

Partner closely with data science on the definition, evaluation and iteration of ranking and recommendation models.

Maintain strong judgement around responsible, transparent and editorially-aligned personalisation — preserving journalistic breadth and integrity.

Work closely with Editorial to ensure discovery and personalisation reflect journalistic judgement and trust, and that the right feedback loops are in place.

Collaborate with Web and App teams to ensure consistent, high-quality implementation of discovery and personalisation experiences across platforms.

Define and track success metrics related to findability, relevance, engagement, habit formation and trust.

Communicate strategy, priorities and performance clearly to senior stakeholders across product, editorial and technology.

The ideal skills for this role are:

Builder: You have owned and shipped complex search, discovery, recommendation or personalisation systems in content-rich or subscription products.

AI-fluent: You have hands-on experience defining and evaluating generative AI features — you understand the product, trust and editorial considerations that make AI experiences succeed or fail.

Data-informed: Comfortable working with data scientists on ML-driven systems, evaluation frameworks and experimentation.

Product-led: Strong judgement in defining strategy, translating it into roadmaps, and delivering outcomes through cross-functional teams in lean environments.

Editorially-aware: Confident balancing user intent, algorithmic optimisation and editorial integrity.

Communicator: Able to explain complex systems and trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Collaborative: Comfortable learning, iterating and working across disciplines — engineering, data science, design and editorial — in a fast-moving environment.

Domain knowledge

Search and discovery systems, including semantic retrieval, ranking and evaluation.

Personalisation systems, behavioral signals and experimentation.

Generative AI product development and conversational interface best practices.

Responsible AI, algorithmic transparency and human-in-the-loop design.

Metrics for discovery quality, relevance, user understanding and trust.

Subscription or habit-forming digital products.

Multi-format digital content environments.

Enthusiasm for The Economist's mission, journalism and global audience.

title: Odoo Application Support & Product Specialist

We are looking for an analytical and problem-solving Odoo Application Support Specialist to ensure the smooth day-to-day operation of our Odoo ERP system. In this role, you will act as the primary point of escalation for all Odoo-related issues. You need to deeply understand how standard business processes (Sales, Inventory, Accounting, etc.) map to Odoo's functionalities. Your main objective is to assist in troubleshooting Odoo's issues from issue documentation and identification, help analyze and assist in resolving user inquiries at first hand, investigate data anomalies, and ensure business continuity without always relying on the core development team. Furthermore, you will act as the primary owner for scoping, exploring, and managing any new technical functionalities or third-party integrations (such as AI agents or Claude AI) to expand and enhance the Odoo ecosystem.




Key Responsibilities

1. Issue Resolution & Troubleshooting:

- Act as the Level 1 technical and functional support for all Odoo ERP users across departments.

- Identify, analyze, investigate, and assist in resolving system issues or workflow bottlenecks reported by users.

- Read and analyze system logs or error tracebacks to determine if an issue is a user error, a configuration issue, or a technical bug.




2. Business Process & Functional Support:

- Guide and educate end-users on the correct way to utilize Odoo features according to the company's Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

- Assist user in performing data corrections and adjustments within Odoo safely (e.g., fixing stuck inventory moves, correcting journal entries).

- Identify recurring user issues and propose process improvements or create Knowledge Base articles/FAQs to reduce future support tickets.




3. Technical support Escalation & Collaboration:

- Filter and validate technical bugs before escalating them to the Odoo Development/Technical team.

- Provide clear, reproducible steps and context to developers to speed up the bug-fixing process.

- Assist in testing bug fixes and patches deployed by developers in a staging environment before they are released to production.




4. System Enhancement & New Integrations:

- Act as the primary owner and project lead for any new technical functionalities to be built or integrated with Odoo.

- Research, scope, and manage third-party integrations, including exploring emerging technologies like AI agents (e.g., Claude AI integration).

- Bridge the gap between business needs and technical execution for system expansions, ensuring new integrations align with existing Odoo architecture.




Job Requirements

- Education: Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, IT, or a related field.

- Experience: 1–3 years of experience providing application support or working as a Functional Consultant specifically for Odoo ERP.

- Strong understanding of core Odoo modules (e.g., Inventory, Sales, Purchase, Accounting) and how they interact with one another.

- Ability to quickly understand diverse business workflows and translate user complaints into systemic Odoo functions.

- Ability to read and understand Python error logs and tracebacks.

- Basic to intermediate knowledge to query data during investigations.

- Understanding of Odoo's technical settings.

- Strong interest or basic knowledge in system integrations, RESTful APIs, and connecting third-party applications to Odoo.

- Forward-thinking mindset with an eagerness to explore and implement new technologies (such as AI tools) into existing ERP workflows.

- Project management mindset with the ability to take ownership of new system features from exploration to deployment.

title: Data Architecture & Modelling
job_description:
About the job

Role Purpose

Designing, governing, and evolving the organization’s enterprise data architecture and data models to ensure data is trusted, compliant, structured (standardized), interoperable (integrated), and fit for business and analytical & AI use.




Role Description

Data Architecture & Modelling Role is responsible for designing, governing, and evolving the organization’s enterprise data architecture and data models to ensure data is trusted, compliant, structured (standardized), interoperable (integrated), and fit for business and analytical & AI use. This role plays a critical part in embedding data governance principles—including data quality, lineage, metadata, standards, and ownership—into the core data architecture across operational, analytical, and cloud platforms. The role partners closely with Data Engineering, Analytics, Data Security & Privacy, and Business stakeholders to ensure data assets are consistently defined, well-structured, and compliant with regulatory and organizational policies.




Key Responsibilities

Define data architecture & data modelling standards aligned with data governance framework.
Define data classification and data domains.
Collaborate with data owners and data stewards to identify critical data elements (CDE), assigned data classifcation & domain and define business/technical relationships..
Collaborate with data owner and data stewards to define entities, attributes, relationships, keys, constraints, hierarchies and other critical information used for data modelling.
Design and maintain conceptual, logical, and physical data models aligned with data architecture & modelling standards.
Ensure data models design support data quality, data lineage, metadata management, and traceability.
Collaborate with data engineers and technology teams to ensure data architecture & modelling standards are implemented.
Collaborate with data engineer, business (data owners & data steward) and technology (IT) to capture data flow, integration, and system landscape diagrams across operational (application systems) and data analytical platforms.
Ensure data architecture and data models are documented, version-controlled, and compliant with governance standards.
Review data architecture and modelling solution designs to ensure alignment with data governance policies, regulatory compliance, and meeting privacy & security requirements.
Design and maintain metadata inventory to improve discoverability: business glossaries, data catalogues and data lineage. Integrate metadata inventory into metadata management tools (ex. GCP DataPlex).




Qualifications

Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Architecture, Data Engineering or related fields.
5+ years in data architecture or enterprise data modelling design.
Strong experience with data platforms, integration patterns, and data modelling.
Knowledge of governance, privacy, and security architecture
Ability to influence architecture decisions without direct authority
Knowledge of data modelling design with canonical data model (CDM) and SID TMForum Framework.
Strong understanding on Data Modelling design process for logical and physical data model.
Proven experience with data modelling tools (e.g ER & UML).
Proven experience with physical data design and advanced SQL in BigQuery database.
Ability to capture business process, data flow diagram and system/data architecture landscape.
Knowledge of metadata, data lineage, and data governance tools.
Knowledge of data integration and ETL/ELT

Drive continuous improvement initiatives using Lean and process optimization methodologies.

Promote standardization and discipline across planning and logistics processes.

7. Risk Management

Develop mitigation plans and escalation routines to ensure continuity of operations.

About VIDA

VIDA is a digital identity company on a mission to make trust simple, secure, and accessible in a digital-first world. We work with enterprises and institutions to prevent fraud, enable compliant growth, and protect users through cutting-edge identity verification and risk intelligence solutions.

As fraud continues to evolve in scale and sophistication—especially with AI-driven attack vectors—VIDA is building a world-class fraud and risk capability grounded in data, science, and real-world impact.

We are looking for a Fraud Analyst to join our Data Science organization and work closely with our Chief Data Science Officer. This role sits at the intersection of fraud intelligence, data analysis, and product impact.

You will analyze fraud patterns across identity verification, onboarding, and transaction flows; generate actionable insights; and help inform both model development and business decisions. This is a hands-on role with high visibility and the opportunity to shape how VIDA detects, understands, and mitigates fraud at scale.

Key Responsibilities

Fraud Analysis & Intelligence


 Analyze fraud trends, patterns, and anomalies across VIDA’s products and client use cases.

Process & Strategy Support

 Required Qualifications

 Proficiency in SQL; experience with Python is a strong plus. 
 Experience working with fraud, risk, identity, payments, or trust & safety data. 
 Ability to clearly communicate insights to both technical and non-technical audiences. 


 Preferred Qualifications 


 Experience in digital identity, fintech, payments, or cybersecurity environments. 
 Familiarity with machine learning concepts and how fraud models are built and evaluated. 
 Experience working with large-scale or real-time data systems. 
 Exposure to global fraud patterns and cross-market risk dynamics.

 Strong sense of ownership and accountability.

 Why Join VIDA 


 Work directly with senior leadership and influence core product and risk strategy.

 Grow your expertise at the frontier of identity, AI, and fraud prevention.

About the job

AIPDRM - Full Stack Developer IT Specialist

Program Overview

The Australia-Indonesia Partnership in Disaster Risk Management (SIAP SIAGA) is a seven-year program that commenced in late 2019, funded by the Australian Government’s Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (DFAT) and implemented in cooperation with the Government of Indonesia (GoI). SIAP SIAGA aims at improving Indonesia’s ability to prevent, prepare for, respond to and recover from disasters and strengthen cooperation between Australia and Indonesia in humanitarian issues in the region. SIAP SIAGA is implemented at the national and sub-national levels though collaboration with the National Disaster Management Authority (BNPB), the Ministry of Home Affairs, the National Development Planning Agency (BAPPENAS), the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the Local Disaster Management Agencies (BPBD) and other national and local government institutions, civil society organizations and academia.

SIAP SIAGA is focused on achieving four ends of program outcomes (EOPOs):


 EOPO 1: GoI’s disaster risk reduction systems are strengthened, resulting in better domestic leadership of disaster management.
 EOPO 2: Target provinces, districts and villages are better able to prepare for, adapt, prevent, respond to and recover from disasters.
 EOPO 3: Strengthened cooperation between Australia and Indonesia on disaster risk management and preparedness regionally.
 EOPO 4: Strengthened learning, innovation, cooperation and inclusion for disaster management.


It is progressing towards these outcomes by focusing on eight priority programs of the GoI: (1) enhancement of disaster management systems; (2) enhancement of disaster management strategy; (3) mapping and evaluation of disaster risks; (4) enhancement of data service, information management, and communication in disaster management; (5) enhancement and development of policies and regulations for disaster preparedness; (6) increasing the quality of disaster emergency management; (7) enhancement of the quality of post disaster policy; and (8) increasing local capacity of disaster management logistics and equipment.

To strengthen the disaster management system, SIAP SIAGA provides strategic technical advice to align national and local policies with international commitments. This effort focuses on embedding gender mainstreaming, institutionalizing disability inclusion, and supporting climate change adaptation across disaster risk reduction, preparedness, response, and recovery processes, through collaboration with national and local partners.

At the sub-national level, SIAP SIAGA works with four provinces in Indonesia: East Java, Bali, West Nusa Tenggara, and East Nusa Tenggara. It also promotes disaster management initiatives and innovations through its outreach program to up to six other provinces.

Purpose Of The Position

Under the direction of national program lead, The IT Fullstack Developer Specialist for Disaster Knowledge Management System (DKMS) BNPB will provide technical support for maintenance, refinement and addition of knowledge documents through the DKMS platform and updating the DKMS Roadmap document until 2030 at BNPB.  Supporting the integration of knowledge and the results from SIAP SIAGA program that can be used widely by various stakeholders to improve coordination, monitoring, and decision-making from ministries/agencies through better data management.
 Updating the DKMS Roadmap document until 2030with the latest developments and projected needs of utilization of Artificial Intelligence until 2030 to make it remain relevant.
 The consultant will coordinate the resulting product with relevant ministries/agencies and support the institutionalization and sustainable integration of the platform into disaster data and information systems.

 Maintaining the DKMS website’s front-end to make it easier for users, especially local governments and the public, to access and contribute to the repository.

Expected Key Results

Working under the direction of the National Program Lead, the Developer - DKMS BNPB will produce the following Results:


 The DKMS platform runs smoothly in terms of website performance, ease of access, server stability, and AI performance for document search and summary features.

Working closely with local communities, we operate across sectors including food production, crafts, and trekking experiences. Each initiative is designed to generate long-term income, build skills, and create lasting opportunities for local families. 

We collaborate with partners across hospitality and retail to bring locally produced goods and experiences to market, while continuously working to improve our environmental practices in a challenging natural environment.

The Marketing & Communications Manager will lead the development and implementation of marketing and communications for the Muntigunung Community Social Enterprises.

title: Quality Control Engineer
job_description:
A key responsibility of the QC Engineer is to maintain and oversee NDT compliance, including ensuring that NDT personnel qualifications meet required standards and that inspections such as visual testing and other NDT methods are conducted properly. The position also requires reviewing inspection records and maintaining proper documentation in the Master Control System, ensuring all quality reports, inspection records, and data books are accurate and issued in a timely manner.

Operationally, the QC Engineer supervises daily shop floor inspection activities, conducts project briefings with inspectors, and coordinates closely with production teams to ensure inspection requirements align with manufacturing schedules. The role also involves preparing and updating quality plans, Inspection Test Plans (ITP), and inspection notifications, as well as issuing test requests and coordinating testing activities with vendors and third-party service providers.

The QC Engineer plays a critical role in identifying and managing nonconformities (NCRs) by initiating reports, conducting root cause analysis, and implementing corrective and improvement actions to prevent recurrence. The role also requires regular communication and coordination with customers, third-party inspectors (TPI), and vendors during inspection and surveillance activities, ensuring transparency and prompt response to customer complaints or quality issues.

In addition, the QC Engineer is responsible for monitoring inspection results, reviewing NDT findings, verifying calibration of inspection tools and equipment, and ensuring the validity of inspection data. The role includes preparing weekly reports on QC activities for the QHSE Manager, as well as generating monthly statistics on welder performance. The QC Engineer may also be required to plan QC resources for weekend work to meet production and customer requirements.

From a governance and compliance perspective, the QC Engineer ensures adherence to Oil States Industries’ HSE policies and Quality Management System, participates in internal and external vendor audits, and contributes to continuous improvement initiatives aimed at strengthening quality control processes.

The position requires a bachelor’s degree in engineering or equivalent, along with professional certifications such as AWS or CSWIP Welding Inspector and ASNT NDT Level II or equivalent. Strong technical knowledge of relevant standards—including API 6A, API 16A, API 16C, API 1104, API STD 64, NACE MR0175, ASME Section VIII and IX, and ASTM NDT standards—is essential.

Candidates are expected to have a minimum of seven years of experience as a QC Engineer, including at least four years in the manufacturing, repair, or remanufacturing of drilling equipment and tubular products, as well as experience supervising inspection teams, training personnel, and participating in quality audits. Strong communication, leadership, teamwork, and presentation skills, along with the ability to effectively manage quality-related issues with internal and external stakeholders, are critical for success in this role.

Ensure compliance with quality management, occupational safety, environmental, and health procedures in all equipment‑related activities.

Familiarity with equipment reliability, safety, and compliance requirements.

Responsibilities

Establish and maintain procedures for production welding and welding personnel, to ensure compliance with specifications, processes, and heating requirements. Prepare and maintain Welding Procedure Specification Matrix and Welders Qualification matrix.

Pre-empt welding problems through the evaluation of new techniques, materials, new equipment requirements and training needs.

Prepare technical reports to showcase the results of Research & Development, enhancements to product quality and welding process, preventive maintenance.

Perform all other reasonable duties as required by Manager.

Participate, as required, in Quality and EHS audits from API and other external organisations.

Requirements

Degree/Diploma in Engineering or equivalent

Minimum 3 years of experience as a Welding Engineer.

Proven track record as a Welding Engineer.

Minimum 3 years of experience working in a Manufacturing environment, preferably in the Oil & Gas Industry. 

Applied knowledge of welding activities for all types of steels including carbon steel, stainless steel, high and low alloy steel.

Knowledge of international codes such as API 1104, API 5L, API 6A, API 16A, API 16R, API 16C, ASME sect IX and AWS D1.1.

APTAVIS membuka kesempatan bagi talenta kreatif dan analitis yang tertarik pada dunia Artificial Intelligence, Large Language Models (LLM), dan automasi untuk bergabung sebagai Prompt Engineer.


Tanggung Jawab Utama

1. Merancang, mengembangkan, dan mengoptimalkan prompt untuk berbagai kebutuhan (chatbot, voice bot, analisis data, AI agent, dsb).

2. Melakukan testing dan iterasi cepat untuk meningkatkan akurasi dan stabilitas output model.

3. Membuat prompt template, guidelines, SOP, dan best practices yang akan digunakan oleh internal tim.

4. Berkolaborasi dengan tim Product, Engineering, dan QA untuk integrasi prompt ke aplikasi, fungsi API, maupun agent workflow.

5. Berkoordinasi dengan tim Marketing & Creative untuk menghasilkan konten AI yang sesuai dengan brand tone dan kualitas yang diinginkan.

6. Menganalisis output model (error, halusinasi, bias, ketidakkonsistenan) dan memberikan rekomendasi perbaikan.

7. Mendokumentasikan seluruh prompt, konfigurasi, hasil pengujian, skenario penggunaan, dan limitasi model.

8. Mengikuti perkembangan teknologi AI/LLM terbaru (GPT, Gemini, Claude, Llama, agentic AI, automasi, dll).

9. Memberikan edukasi internal mengenai cara penggunaan AI yang efektif dan aman untuk tim dan klien.


Kualifikasi

1. Pendidikan minimal S1 (diutamakan Informatika, Sistem Informasi, Data Science, Linguistik, Komunikasi, atau bidang terkait).

2. Pengalaman merancang prompt LLM (GPT/Gemini/Claude/Llama) adalah nilai tambah besar.

3. Memiliki pemikiran kritis, analitis, dan logis dalam memecahkan masalah.

4. Menyukai eksperimen dan mampu melakukan iterasi prompt secara cepat dan terukur.

5. Memahami dasar-dasar AI/ML, NLP, atau arsitektur sistem (tidak harus mendalam, namun mampu memahami konsep).

6. Mampu menulis dengan jelas, terstruktur, dan komunikatif.

7. Terbiasa melakukan riset dan analisis untuk memahami perilaku model AI modern.

8. Memiliki kemampuan problem-solving, debugging prompt sederhana, dan memperbaiki respons AI.

9. Memiliki orientasi terhadap detail, kualitas output, dan konsistensi.


Nilai Tambah (Nice to Have)

* Berpengalaman menggunakan tools seperti OpenAI Playground, HuggingFace, LangSmith, Postman, RAG tools, atau agent frameworks.

* Memahami function calling, vector database, atau integrasi API.

* Familiar dengan pengujian AI: latensi, akurasi, grounding, hallucination checks.

* Portofolio eksperimen prompt (dokumen, GitHub, Notion, atau studi kasus).

title: Business Data Analytics Lead
job_description:
About the job

Who are we?

Amar Bank is one of the most technologically advanced digital banks in Indonesia. Our leading

digital lending product, Tunaiku has the distinction of being the first FinTech product in

Indonesia. We are also the first digital bank on the cloud. As the first profitable digital bank, we

managed to get listed on the Indonesian Stock Exchange.

How did we manage to do that?

We are changing people’s perception of a bank. We believe we are the innovators who combine

customer focus principles with creating technology-based impact. We incorporate freedom and

flexibility as part of our startup working culture DNA to encourage innovation in creating better

financial solutions for the banking industry. We think of ourselves as, ‘A technology company

with a banking license’. For this reason, we ‘Act like a FinTech, and think like a Bank.’

How did it all start?

Founded on March 15, 1991, in Surabaya as PT Anglomas International Bank (Amin Bank), the

bank was acquired by Tolaram Group and transformed to PT Bank Amar Indonesia (Amar Bank)

in 2014. It has then undergone a significant digital transformation to become one of the

country's forerunning fintech institutions through its award-winning digital lending platform,

Tunaiku.

Our philosophy, mission, and vision

Technology must impact lives, must improve lives. We exist to provide banking to those who

‘need’ and not only to those who ‘want’. Services when provided to those who need at the time

of their need brings smiles. Our vision is to bring 200 million smiles.

More About The Bank With Startup Culture Environment

Consist of 1000+ people, you will meet people who love to grow, dream big, and actually have

fun at the workplace! We provide a great working environment that pushes people to grow

outside their comfort zone. People with high drive and ambition find us a very attractive place to

work as their career growth matches their own drive and not any staid policies. Thus we hold

the honor of being awarded “Best Place to Work in Indonesia”.

Recently Amar Bank was awarded as Inspirational Brand from APEA (Asia Pacific Enterprise

Awards) 2022. Of course, our innovation won't stop here. So if you would love to be a part of it,

have a growth mindset, and are constantly hungry for challenges, we invite you to join us in our

journey to ‘Impact Lives’.

Join us today and create #unlimitedinnovations!

Responsibilities


Analytical Leadership & Ownership
Act as the primary authority for analyses used in management, executive, and regulatory decision-making
Ensure every analysis has clear ownership, decision context, documented assumptions, and known limitations
Build and enforce an ownership mindset where analysts are accountable for the impact and interpretation of their insights
Expectation Management & Stakeholder Leadership
Manage expectations of business users and leadership on what data can reliably answer, including scope, precision, and timelines
Reframe ambiguous or high-risk requests into defensible analytical questions
Provide clear pushback, alternatives, or mitigations when requests cannot be safely fulfilled
Analytical Risk Mitigation
Identify and mitigate risks related to misleading metrics, invalid comparisons, biased data, or unstable assumptions
Prevent misuse or over-interpretation of analysis by clearly communicating analytical boundaries
Treat analytical errors and misinterpretations as decision risks, not merely technical issues
Team Leadership & Culture Building
Mentor and guide data analysts to think in terms of decisions, consequences, and accountability rather than task completion
Establish a strong review culture focused on assumptions, judgment, and decision impact
Shield analysts from ad-hoc pressure and scope creep by managing escalation and alignment at the leadership level
Analytical Standards & Governance
Define, maintain, and enforce consistent metric definitions and analytical standards across the organization
Ensure analytical outputs are interpretable, reproducible, and appropriately documented
Collaborate with Data Engineering and other teams on analytical meaning and definitions (not infrastructure ownership)
Deliverables
Clearly defined and maintained metric definitions used across key business and management reports
Reviewed and approved analyses that are safe, defensible, and ready for decision-making use
Documented assumptions, limitations, and ownership for major analyses
A data analyst team that demonstrates accountability, sound judgment, and confidence in their outputs
Reduced disputes and confusion caused by inconsistent or misunderstood data
Trusted analytical inputs for leadership, board-level discussions, and regulatory-facing materials



Requirements


Experience
Minimum 7 years of experience in data analysis, analytics, or business intelligence roles
Proven experience leading, reviewing, or owning analyses used in high-impact business decisions
Experience in banking, financial services, lending, risk, or other regulated environments is strongly preferred
Technical & Analytical Skills
Advanced SQL proficiency (BigQuery or equivalent)
Strong understanding of data modeling concepts and analytical best practices
Ability to identify analytical bias, data leakage, invalid comparisons, and misinterpretation risks
Capable of critically reviewing analysis without reliance on owning data infrastructure or pipelines
Leadership & Behavioral Competencies
Demonstrated ability to manage stakeholder expectations and push back with calm authority
Strong sense of personal and team accountability for analytical outcomes
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Comfortable operating in ambiguous, high-pressure, and incomplete-data environments
High integrity, consistency in judgment, and willingness to take responsibility when analysis contributes to poor outcomes



We exist to innovate and maintain the architecture of Amar Bank's products. As part of our main focus to create through technology we ensure the process and technology we use helps maintain and build human connection at scale.

It’s our job to plan, monitor, and control the technology growth so we can provide a faster, more convenient, and more efficient way of performing business transactions.

The primary project involves bridging RS485/Modbus field devices to desktop data readers using wireless technology, with intrinsic safety barriers at zone boundaries. This person will assess logger communication capability, integration options, data flow, security, cloud architecture, dashboard requirements, implementation risk, and rollout readiness. The output of this role is not only code, but also a practical and executable technical blueprint for the project. This scope matches the major layers used in industrial IoT solutions: field connectivity, interoperability, device authentication, telemetry ingestion, and dashboard/alerting




Experience

• Minimum 5 years of experience in IoT system integration, industrial automation, or instrumentation engineering

• At least 2 years of hands-on experience with LPWAN technologies (LoRa/LoRaWAN, NB-IoT, or Sigfox)

• Proven experience with RS485/Modbus RTU protocol in industrial environments

• Experience working in or with ATEX/IECEx classified environments (oil & gas, petrochemical, chemical, pharmaceutical, or similar)




Core skills to screen for:

Industrial protocols: MQTT, Modbus RTU/TCP, OPC UA, REST, WebSocket

Networking: TCP/IP, VPN, APN, routing basics, RS485, serial debugging

Cloud/backend: IoT platform design, brokers, ingestion, APIs, time-series storage

Security: TLS, certificates, IAM/RBAC, secrets handling

Architecture: solution design, tradeoff analysis, documentation

Execution: feasibility study, scope definition, risk assessment, budgeting support

Communication: vendor coordination, stakeholder presentation, technical writing




Success criteria for the first 60–90 days

Complete assessment of current logger/device capability.

Deliver recommended end-to-end architecture.

Deliver integration decision: direct, gateway-based, or middleware-based.

Produce risk register and list of technical dependencies.

Produce implementation roadmap, estimated effort, and recommended team structure.

Identify whether firmware, gateway, backend, or dashboard customization is required

title: IB Diploma Programme Coordinator
job_description:
Key Responsibilities

Curriculum Leadership & Implementation

Lead the strategic implementation, monitoring, and evaluation of the IB Diploma Programme (DP), ensuring alignment with the IB philosophy, Programme Standards and Practices, and relevant SPK regulations.

Support subject teachers and core component supervisors (TOK, CAS, EE) in curriculum planning, ensuring vertical and horizontal alignment, academic rigor, and interdisciplinary connections.

Guide the integration of international-mindedness, ATL (Approaches to Learning), and IB Learner Profile attributes across all subjects.

Ensure accurate and timely submission of IB documentation, programme evaluation reports, subject outlines, and internal assessments.

Collaborate with MYP and PYP coordinators to ensure a cohesive IB continuum.

Instructional Supervision & Professional Development

Provide ongoing pedagogical leadership and mentorship to DP faculty through lesson observations, reflective dialogue, and targeted feedback.

Identify faculty professional development needs and coordinate or deliver training sessions aligned with IB best practices and programme developments.

Foster a collaborative professional learning culture focused on inquiry, innovation, assessment literacy, and student agency.

Student Development & Well-being

Monitor and support the academic progress and emotional well-being of all DP students through collaboration with homeroom teachers, counselors, and parents.

Oversee the implementation and quality of the core components—Theory of Knowledge (TOK), Creativity, Activity, Service (CAS), and the Extended Essay (EE).

Support students in managing workload, deadlines, and the development of time management, research, and self-management skills necessary for success in the DP.

Parent & Community Engagement

Advise students and parents on DP course selections, university applications, and academic pathways.

Communicate effectively with parents and guardians regarding DP curriculum, expectations, and student progress through meetings, workshops, and newsletters.

Build partnerships with universities, alumni, and external organizations to enrich the student experience and facilitate career and university readiness

Coordinate the promotion and understanding of the DP within the broader school community to ensure shared ownership and support.

Operational & Administrative Leadership

Oversee all administrative aspects of the DP, including exam registration, IBIS data management, internal assessments, predicted grades, and the organization of mock and final examinations.

Ensure full compliance with IB policies, deadlines, and procedures, and serve as the liaison with the IB organization.

Participate as an active member of the school leadership team, contributing to school-wide planning, evaluation, and strategic development.




Background Experiences

Minimum 5 years of experience teaching in upper secondary education (Grades 11–12), with at least 2 years in a leadership, coordination, or IB Diploma Programme role.

Demonstrated success in implementing the IB Diploma Programme, including experience guiding students through the core components: TOK, CAS, and Extended Essay.

Prior experience in SPK, international, or bilingual schools is highly preferred.

Experience supporting diverse learners, including multilingual students, within a rigorous academic framework.

Proven track record of curriculum leadership, instructional coaching, and program evaluation within the DP context.

Familiarity with national education standards in Indonesia and how they integrate with international curricula, particularly IB DP.




Professional & Educational Qualifications

Master’s degree in Education, Curriculum & Instruction, Educational Leadership, or a related field.

IB DP-specific training (e.g., Category 1, 2, or 3 workshops, or DP Coordinator training) is required.

Strong understanding of the IB DP Standards and Practices, and experience in curriculum planning, assessment, and reporting within the Diploma Programme.

High proficiency in English (spoken and written) is essential; working knowledge of Bahasa Indonesia is advantageous for communication with stakeholders.




Expertise & Competencies

1.     Curriculum & Instructional Leadership

In-depth knowledge of the IB DP framework, subject group requirements, and the nature of the core components (TOK, CAS, EE).

Skilled in leading curriculum articulation, interdisciplinary planning, and ensuring alignment with IB expectations and school goals.

2.     Academic Excellence & Student Agency

Strong commitment to fostering student-oriented learning environments, inquiry, and international-mindedness.

Ability to support high academic standards while nurturing students' well-being, autonomy, and critical thinking.

3.     Instructional Coaching & Faculty Development

Demonstrated ability to mentor and develop teaching staff through feedback, coaching cycles, and collaborative reflection.

Skilled in organizing and facilitating high-impact professional development tailored to the needs of DP educators.

4.     Assessment & Data-Driven Practices

Proficient in managing DP assessment systems, including internal assessments, predicted grades, and exam readiness.

Uses assessment data to support instructional decisions, student learning, and programme review.

Proficiency in educational technology and data management systems.




5.     University Guidance & Stakeholder Communication

Experience in supporting university application processes, including writing references and aligning with global higher education expectations.

Effective communicator with students, parents, faculty, and IB personnel.

6.     Programme Innovation & Compliance

Ability to lead and sustain programme development aligned with IB updates and accreditation processes.

Experience managing IBIS platform, IB deadlines, and programme self-study or evaluation requirements.




Work Environment & Expectations

Lead and coordinate all aspects of the IB Diploma Programme (Grades 11–12), ensuring quality teaching, learning, and assessment practices.

Collaborate with the Senior Principal, Head of School, and leadership team to align the DP with whole-school strategic goals.

Monitor and support the implementation of TOK, CAS, and the Extended Essay, ensuring consistency and depth in student experiences.

Stay updated with IB DP developments and act as the school’s primary liaison with the IB organization.

Full-time role with occasional evening or weekend commitments for parent meetings, student exhibitions, university events, or IB deadlines.

Ensure the smooth operation of the DP through effective planning, exam coordination, and ongoing compliance with IB and national education regulations.

Collaborative, multicultural environment in an SPK school, requiring adaptability to Indonesian cultural norms and SPK regulations.

Expected to lead professional development, attend IB workshops, and contribute to school-wide initiatives.




Reporting Line & Organizational Structure

Reports to: Senior School Principal and Head of School (P–12)

Collaborates with: Subject Teachers, Core Component Coordinators (TOK, CAS, EE), Student Support Team, and School Leadership Team

Oversees: DP teaching staff and subject leads within the Diploma Programme

The Search Operations team aims to improve search user experience, contribute significant DAU impact to the products and drive for increase in traffic and GMV.

title: QA Intern
job_description:
About the job

Kinobi AI is a Singapore-based company dedicated to transforming higher education by helping universities go beyond just academics. We focus on holistic student success, leveraging AI-powered solutions to ensure that students are well-prepared for their careers. We're looking for individuals who share our vision and want to make a meaningful impact in the future of education.

Our purpose is to:


Empower institutions to guide their beneficiaries toward meaningful employment opportunities through AI-driven solutions
Demonstrate to the world that a global AI-powered B2B SaaS enterprise can be successfully built from Southeast Asia



About The Role

The QA Intern (Manual, with exposure to Automation) will support the QA team by primarily performing manual testing to ensure our software products meet defined quality standards. Experience or strong interest in automation testing—particularly API testing and Playwright—is a plus.

This role is ideal for candidates who enjoy deep analytical thinking, problem-solving, and investigating complex issues. You will gain hands-on experience in identifying defects, performing root-cause analysis, and collaborating with cross-functional teams and international clients to deliver high-quality products.

Key Responsibilities


Perform comprehensive manual testing across staging, UAT, and production environments to identify defects, inconsistencies, and edge cases.
Investigate issues deeply by analyzing application behavior, browser console logs, network activity, and error responses to identify root causes.
Identify, document, and report bugs clearly, including detailed steps to reproduce, expected vs actual results, and supporting evidence (logs, screenshots, recordings).
Apply critical and deep thinking to uncover hidden issues and understand complex system behavior, not just surface-level defects.
Collaborate closely with international teams across different time zones to support and execute testing strategies.
Be proactive and outspoken when identifying risks, recurring issues, or potential impacts on product quality and client satisfaction.
Support basic automation testing efforts (API testing, Playwright) when applicable or during learning opportunities.



Qualifications


Basic understanding of software testing concepts and QA processes.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to think deeply when diagnosing complex or recurring issues.
Experience or willingness to learn console log inspection, network debugging, and error investigation as part of the testing process.
High attention to detail with the ability to identify functional inconsistencies and edge cases.
Ability to adapt quickly to new tools, technologies, and workflows in a fast-paced environment.
Open to candidates from various academic backgrounds; a strong interest in Quality Assurance is essential.
English proficiency is mandatory, as you will work with international teams. Strong written and verbal communication skills are required.
Ability to commit to a 3–6 month internship.
Comfortable working in a hybrid or remote work environment



Additional Information:


All interviews and communication will be conducted in English.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

In this role, you will conduct deep fundamental analysis on publicly listed Indonesian equities, contribute to portfolio construction, and work closely with senior investment professionals.

What you'll do:

Conduct rigorous bottom-up fundamental research on Indonesian listed companies across assigned sectors
Build and maintain detailed financial models, including DCF, relative valuation, and scenario analysis
Prepare investment theses, initiation reports, and periodic company/sector updates
Attend earnings calls, company visits, and investor relations meetings; synthesize key takeaways
Monitor macroeconomic developments, regulatory changes, and sector dynamics relevant to the portfolio
Collaborate with portfolio managers on position sizing, entry/exit decisions, and portfolio construction
Present investment ideas clearly and concisely in internal investment committee discussions
Track and evaluate alternative data, flow signals, and quantitative indicators to complement qualitative research




Qualifications

We welcome fresh graduates and candidates with up to 5 years of relevant experience who demonstrate strong analytical ability and interest in investing.

Background in equity research, investment banking, corporate finance, or related roles with exposure to financial analysis and investment research
Strong financial modeling skills and solid understanding of accounting fundamentals (including consolidated financials and IFRS)
Ability to form independent, well-reasoned investment views and communicate them effectively
High attention to detail, with strong written and verbal communication skills in Bahasa Indonesia and English
Proficiency in Excel; familiarity with Bloomberg, Refinitiv, or IDX data platforms is a plus

Additional considerations:

CFA candidacy, MBA, or equivalent analytical training is a plus
Demonstrated interest in Indonesian equities or capital markets is advantageous




Selection Process

Shortlisted candidates may be invited to submit a brief investment thesis (1–2 pages) on an IDX-listed company as part of the evaluation process. Any materials submitted are used solely for candidate assessment purposes and will not be used for commercial decision-making.




Required Skills

Equity Research

Indonesian Equities (IDX)

title: Website Builder & Content Publisher [UI/UX Experience]
job_description:
Who We Are

Contracting Empire is a marketing agency that works exclusively with high-ticket contractors in the US. We build websites, SEO, local SEO, and paid media systems that move the needle for our clients. We're not a checkbox agency, and we're not looking for checkbox people.

The Role

We're looking for a Website Builder & Content Publisher who takes real ownership of how our clients' websites look, function, and grow. 

You'll build pages in WordPress using Elementor, publish SEO content from our writing team, and make sure every page that goes live is clean, consistent, and something to be proud of.

This isn't a "just upload and push publish" job. You're the last set of eyes before anything goes live.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

Website Building

Build website pages using Elementor's drag-and-drop interface on existing site kits

Set menus, navigation links, and internal structure according to established site architecture

Add and configure contact forms, widgets, buttons, images, and other elements when the site kit doesn't provide them

Content Publishing

Publish blog posts, city pages, service pages, and other SEO content provided by our writing team, on both existing templates and pages built from scratch

Source or create relevant images to accompany content when none are provided, and prepare them for web use

Implement on-page SEO elements (meta titles, descriptions, tags) provided by the content team

Interlink published content within the site and indexed new pages in Google Search Console

Scheduling & Communication

Collaborate with the content planning team to stay aligned with the editorial calendar

Update content planners daily with publishing status

Communicate clearly with the SEO writing team, flag issues, ask the right questions, and keep things moving without being chased

Quality Assurance

Make sure every page looks right on desktop, tablet, and mobile before it goes live

Ensure consistent formatting, headings, paragraphs, spacing, and visual hierarchy across all published content

Match fonts, colors, and styling to each client's brand guidelines

Custom Styling

Apply custom CSS when Elementor's built-in options aren't enough

Use basic HTML/CSS to create unique sections or effects when needed

Who This Is For

This is for someone who cares about the details, not because someone's watching, but because sloppy work bothers them personally.

This job is for you if:

You're proficient in WordPress and Elementor (or similar platforms), and you're fast in them.

You can communicate in spoken and written English perfectly. We are an international team with US-based clients, so your English needs to be flawless. We will test this. 

You have a strong visual eye, you notice when something is off, and you fix it without being asked.

You're comfortable adapting to new tools and workflows quickly.

You can manage a publishing calendar without constant reminders.

You understand that consistency and attention to detail aren't nice-to-haves; they're the job.

You know CSS/HTML .

You’re an independent thinker who can always put two and two together, and you can spot problems and solve them ASAP.

You have UI/UX experience.

You are a very organized person, can work with Drive files and keep things tidy, and you always meet your deadlines.

You set your own bar. We don't want to tell you how to do your job. You should be able to tell us.

You are proactive and never wait to be told what to do. You have a “I’ll figure it out” mentality.

Are willing to learn, improve, and adapt to all the updates and trends in your field.

English proficiency is non-negotiable. You’ll need to spot mistakes in the copy and communicate with native English speakers. We'll test your English in the first minutes of the interview.

Tools We Use

Web: WordPress, Elementor, Google Search Console, Google Drive 

Design: Photoshop, Illustrator, or equivalent 

Communication: Discord, Basecamp, Loom, Zoom 

AI: All your favorite language models (yes, we expect you to use them)

Benefits & Logistics

Fully remote, with occasional meetups in Bali, living there or being open to relocating is a big advantage

Monday to Friday, full-time, starting at 9 or 10 AM Bali time

Salary based on experience and what you bring to the table. If you're exceptional, your pay will increase

Performance bonuses

12 paid vacation days on top of public holidays, with more added based on seniority

Access to courses, training, and conferences as needed

Once employed: laptop or equipment provided if needed, health coverage & 13th salary

title: Pricing Analyst
job_description:
About the job

Why Coda




Coda is a global growth engine for commerce, connecting people, digital products, and payments through trusted monetization and distribution solutions.







With 600+ people from 57 nationalities across 23 locations, we’re a truly global team headquartered in Singapore, with offices in Amsterdam, Dubai, Bristol, Shanghai, Eindhoven, and across Southeast Asia.




We power global commerce through a dual model. Our B2B solutions, Codapay, Coda Webstore, Coda Links, Coda Distribution, and Giftcloud, enable publishers and brands to monetize and distribute digital content globally. On the consumer side, we operate a portfolio of trusted storefronts including Codashop, Recharge.com, Startselect.com, and mobiletopup.co.uk, that give customers secure and easy access to game top-ups, digital credits, vouchers, gift cards and prepaid products in over 70 markets.




Our culture is built on respect, ownership, and collaboration. We move fast, support each other, and celebrate wins together.




If you’re looking to grow your career and make a real impact in a global team, Coda is the place for you. 





The Opportunity







We’re looking for a talented Pricing Analyst to join us, reporting to our General Manager Codashop. You’ll help us take the next step in our revenue management strategy across our global assortment on our Codashop label.




Within Revenue Management, we continuously optimize pricing and revenue drivers to strike the right balance between growth and profitability. With tens of thousands of products across 60+ countries, 400+ payment methods, and a wide range of customer segments, scalability is key.




In this role, you will work closely with stakeholders from our commercial teams (Category Management, Marketing & Data Science) as well as our Amsterdam based Pricing Manager.





What you'll do



Localize our Recharge product pricing approach towards Codashop


Build and scale consumer fee implementation across products and countries


Analyse short and long term effects of pricing implementation


Communicate effectively with a wide range of stakeholders on activities and outcomes


Optimise and design our price management tooling with Product teams


Optimise our price presentation with our Product and UX teams


Extend and improve competitor scraping with our Pricing Operations team to strengthen our market positioning



What you'll bring


A BSc in Business, Economics, or a related subject


3+ years’ experience in a highly analytical, commercial role in pricing within the digital/e-commerce industry


Strong analytical, quantitative, and critical thinking skills—able to identify trends, generate insights, and translate them into viable business strategies


Proficiency in BI tools (Tableau, PowerBI, etc.) for data access and reporting


Excellent organisational skills, attention to detail, and analytical reasoning


Strong communication and presentation skills (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly convey complex analysis to stakeholders at all levels


A collaborative team player with strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills


Innovative, creative, and commercially astute






We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, embracing the unique qualities of every individual, regardless of gender, race, age, religion, disability, or other local protected classes. Our goal is to foster an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome and valued.




 




Due to the large number of exceptional applications we receive, we can only reach out to shortlisted candidates. If you don't hear from us, rest assured there may be another opportunity at Coda that aligns better with your unique abilities. Remember to check our Careers Page for more exciting job openings!

title: Rekrutmen Data Inputter
job_description:
Latar Belakang

Tuberkulosis (TB) tetap menjadi salah satu tantangan kesehatan masyarakat paling mendesak di Indonesia. Pada tahun 2024, diperkirakan terdapat 1.092.000 kasus TB di Indonesia, dengan 856.420 kasus yang telah dilaporkan, termasuk 12.128 orang dengan TB resisten obat (DR-TB). Meskipun terdapat kemajuan dalam pelaporan kasus, masih terdapat kesenjangan signifikan dalam cakupan dan keterlibatan pengobatan. Sebagai contoh, dari kasus DR-TB yang dilaporkan, hanya 9.573 pasien yang memulai pengobatan. Tingkat keberhasilan pengobatan juga menunjukkan ketimpangan, dengan beberapa wilayah mencatat keberhasilan 85% untuk TB sensitif obat (DS-TB), namun hanya 59% untuk DR-TB. Selain itu, cakupan terapi pencegahan TB (TPT) masih sangat rendah—hanya 19,4% pada tahun 2024.

Selama bertahun-tahun, Indonesia telah menerima dukungan substansial dari berbagai mitra, termasuk Badan Pembangunan Internasional Amerika Serikat (USAID), untuk memperkuat penemuan kasus TB, meningkatkan layanan pengobatan, mendorong keterlibatan masyarakat, dan membangun kolaborasi lintas sektor. Namun, dengan berakhirnya pendanaan program TB dari USAID, sejumlah intervensi penyelamatan jiwa kini menghadapi kesenjangan dukungan yang kritis, yang mengancam keberlanjutan dan kualitas layanan TB di wilayah dengan beban tinggi.

Pemerintah Amerika kembali mendukung Indonesia upaya eliminasi TB melalui Proyek Life-saving Facility and Community-based Service Delivery Support for Tuberculosis (FCSDS) untuk periode Oktober 2025-Maret 2026 yang dirancang untuk mendorong peningkatan penemuan kasus TB secara dini dan membantu pasien dalam mengakses layanan TB yang berkualitas, termasuk diagnosis yang tepat waktu, pengobatan yang efektif, dan pemberian TPT, dengan fokus khusus pada provinsi dan kabupaten yang saat ini menghadapi tantangan terbesar dalam menjaga keberlanjutan layanan TB.

STPI akan memimpin pelaksanaan proyek ini. Melalui kolaborasi erat dengan layanan kesehatan pemerintah, masyarakat sipil, dan aktor komunitas, proyek ini akan memperkuat layanan TB baik di fasilitas kesehatan maupun berbasis komunitas. Kegiatan akan mencakup peningkatan deteksi dini kasus, peningkatan inisiasi dan kepatuhan pengobatan, perluasan cakupan TPT, serta memastikan dukungan pasien sepanjang perjalanan pengobatan. Dengan menjembatani kesenjangan layanan dan menjaga intervensi penting, Proyek FCSDS bertujuan untuk menyelamatkan nyawa, mengurangi penularan TB, dan melindungi komunitas rentan dari epidemi TB yang masih berlangsung di Indonesia.

Pelaksanaan proyek berfokus di Puskesmas, terutama pada upaya investigasi kontak, community outreach,  skrining sistematis TB (SSTB) dan pendampingan orang dengan TB di masyarakat. Data Inputter dibutuhkan untuk menjadi penghubung dan memfasilitasi kebutuhan kader maupun puskesmas untuk pendataan, pemberian insentif, dan pelaporan terkait upaya yang dilakukan dalam rangka pelaksanaan proyek. Sebelumnya Proyek FCSDS telah merekrut untuk posisi Data Entry, yang selanjutnya akan diubah namanya menjadi Data Inputter dengan penyesuaian tugas dan tanggung jawabnya.

Wilayah kerja Data Inputter dapat meliputi satu atau lebih Puskesmas dan akan bertanggung jawab kepada Koordinator Distrik, selain itu koordinasi dengan Wasor TB di Dinas Kesehatan Kabupaten, dan Penanggung Jawab TB di Puskesmas harus terus dilakukan.

Tujuan

Rekrutmen ini bertujuan untuk:

Memenuhi kebutuhan Sumber Daya Manusia dalam hal ini input data untuk Project FCSDS.

Memastikan proses pencatatan dan pelaporan data di lapangan berjalan dengan baik dan tepat waktu.

Memastikan aktivitas pencatatan dan pelaporan yang dijalankan oleh Data Inputter dapat  dikelola dengan baik dan dipantau secara berjenjang oleh District MEL Officer dan District Coordinator.

Pelaksana

Stop TB Partnership Indonesia, melalui proyek Life-Saving FCSDS.

Melakukan input data SSTB setiap hari ke dalam sistem informasi/format database yang telah ditentukan.

Stop TB Partnership Indonesia (STPI), yang secara resmi dikenal sebagai Yayasan Kemitraan Tuberkulosis Indonesia, telah berada di garis depan upaya masyarakat sipil untuk mempercepat eliminasi TB di Indonesia sejak tahun 2018. Selama bertahun-tahun, STPI telah memantapkan dirinya sebagai mitra utama Pemerintah Indonesia, dengan menghimpun komunitas, masyarakat sipil, dan para pemangku kepentingan untuk memperkuat respons nasional terhadap TB. title: Scheduler (Contract Based)

About the job

We’re looking for a Scheduler (Contract Based) to join our Indonesia team.

When you work for us, you get the chance to join nearly 50,000 people all driven by a common purpose of delivering a more sustainable world. We’re excited about the challenges ahead. We believe there’s never been a more rewarding time to work in the energy, chemical and resources sectors.

As a Scheduler, you will be responsible to demonstrate a high level of skill in planning Engineering, Procurement, Construction and Project Management  projects using computer based planning and scheduling techniques

To succeed in this role, you should have experience in mining construction project with a min. 10 years' experience in project scheduling and controls.
 

Who We Are

Worley is a global professional services company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia.

Right now, we’re bridging two worlds as we accelerate to more sustainable energy sources, while helping our customers provide the energy, chemicals and resources that society needs now.

We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value over the life of their portfolio of assets. We solve complex problems by finding integrated data-centric solutions from the first stages of consulting and engineering to installation and commissioning, to the last stages of decommissioning and remediation. Join us and help drive innovation and sustainability in our projects. 


What You'll Do:

We’re looking for a Scheduler to join our Indonesia team.

The role responsibilities include:

Demonstrate a high level of skill in planning Engineering, Procurement, Construction and Project Management  projects using computer based planning and scheduling techniques.

Prepare standardized scheduling documents to be followed by others in the preparation of their area specific schedule and assemble to resulting areas schedules into an integrated schedule along with explanatory reports.

Monitor progress during the study against the study schedule, identify areas of slippage for attention, and forecast the completion date.

Ensure construction work conforms to applicable specifications, codes, and standards.

Promote interdisciplinary communications on projects.

Demonstrate Primavera Project Planning software operating expertise

Ensure project scope, budgets and schedules for construction are effectively communicated and met on projects.

Responsible for implementing modifications to provide a cost-effective planning service within assigned budget constraints.  

What You'll Have: 

Degree in a relevant field or equivalent  

Minimum of 10 years’ experience in project scheduling and controls

Prior experience in mining construction project advantageous

Ability to apply Critical Path Method planning techniques to develop detail Engineering and Installation Project networks and schedules

Focal Point for recommending training and development requirements for any subordinate planning personnel.  

Demonstrate a high level of skill in planning Mining, Minerals and Metals Engineering, Procurement, Construction and Project Management using computer-based planning and scheduling techniques.  

High level of proficiency in Oracle Primavera P6 


Moving forward together

We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation.

We’re building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.

And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology.

Whatever your ambition, there’s a path for you here. And there’s no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

Experienced in performing daily quality control (QC). 

Experience in a middle managerial role is an advantage.

Position Overview:

Your job is to make sure that for every customer trial we open, we know exactly what we have trained on, where coverage is strongest, and what we need next. Data is a product feature.
