Coordinate cross-functional execution with annotation teams, engineering, and domain experts without directly managing them.
Establish a weekly operating cadence and reporting to track coverage progress, identify gaps, and provide leadership with clear visibility on readiness for upcoming trials
Qualifications:

You have 3 to 8 years working on data for an ML or AI product. You have shipped models where data, not modeling, was the constraint.
You have owned a data inventory or coverage taxonomy before — you can describe, with specifics, the schema you used, how you kept it accurate, and how it drove decisions.
You are comfortable with annotation operations. You have worked with labeling teams, you know what schema drift and inter-rater disagreement look like, and you have fixed at least one of them.
You read code well enough to debug a crawler's output and have a substantive conversation with engineers about training data formats. You do not write production code.
You have closed at least one external data-sharing partnership — or you have done equivalent BD-style work that ended in a signed deal.
You are comfortable with construction, or have a track record of going zero-to-credible in a vertical inside 30 days. Senior estimators, GC operations leaders, and BIM managers are people you will be on calls with. You earn their trust quickly.
You think in inventories and prioritization. When something goes wrong twice, your instinct is to fix the queue, not to do the work yourself.

You can communicate fluently in English (written and verbal) to collaborate with our US-based team.

You are comfortable working Indonesia hours with consistent async overlap with US Pacific Time.


Why Join Us:


Our client value and invest in our employees' growth and development. As a member of the team, you will have the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology, collaborate with talented and driven individuals, and make a significant impact on the company's success. 

Our client offer competitive compensation, benefits, and a positive and inclusive work culture. Join us and be a part of our journey to transform talent management.

KBR’s Sustainable Technology Solutions (STS) group is looking for a Civil Engineer to support the Abadi LNG project, one of the largest projects in Asia.  This project will provide front-end design (FEED) for onshore liquefied natural gas facilities & will have a peak production capacity targets of 9.5 million tons per annum of LNG and 150 million standard cubic feet per day of pipeline gas.  The Abadi LNG project has been designated a project of national strategic importance by the Indonesian government.

Responsibilities: 

Prepare design specifications

Support construction, operations, and maintenance activities at project site

Participate in surveying to lay out installations and establish reference points, grades, and elevations to guide construction

Influence and assist clients to determine best possible result within project parameters

Inspect project sites to monitor progress and ensure conformance to design specifications, safety and standards

Perform technical reviews to ensure clarity, completeness, and exactness

Ensure proper communication & coordination between stakeholders, contractors, and other engineering teams

Perform Structural analysis using STAAD PRO

Execute concrete design using Foundation 3D/Mat3D

Complete Hydraulic Calculations & Drainage Calculations

Required Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering or related field

Minimum of 7 years of civil engineering experience, with average experience of 10 + years

Job Title: 

Risk Analytic & Governance Supervisor

About The Role: 

Responsible for supporting the implementation of the Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) framework through the collection, analysis, validation, and reporting of risk data across all company units.

This role focuses on the development of the risk reporting system, management of the risk register, preparation of Key Risk Indicators (KRI), and strengthening of risk governance in accordance with regulatory requirements (Bank Indonesia) and internal company policies. The position plays a role in maintaining the integrity of risk data, ensuring the effectiveness of internal controls, and supporting risk-based decision making.

What Will You Do: 

Collect, validate, and analyze risk data across business and operations, including trend analysis, loss events, incident reports, and control effectiveness using quantitative and qualitative methods.

Develop and maintain data-driven risk dashboards and reports to monitor KRI, EWI, and risk appetite metrics, and present insights to ERM Manager, Risk Committee, and regulators.

Maintain and update the company’s risk governance documentation, including risk registers, control libraries, committee minutes, action items, and follow-up tracking to ensure alignment with internal risk policies.

Support Risk Management Committee activities and regulatory governance by preparing complete, accurate quarterly and annual risk reports while enforcing compliance with internal risk documentation standards.

Support enterprise-wide risk identification and assessment while coordinating mitigation actions with relevant units to ensure timely completion of risk treatment plans.

Promote internal risk awareness and data-driven risk management practices to strengthen a strong risk governance culture across all operational areas.

What we are looking for: 

Minimum Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Management, Finance, Law, Statistics, Mathematics, or Information Technology (Information Systems).

Minimum 3–5 years of experience in risk analytics, governance, audit, compliance, or data risk management within Payment Gateway / Fintech / Banking / Financial Institutions.

Strong understanding of Enterprise Risk Management concepts, COSO/ISO 31000, and risk scoring methodology.

Technical Competency Requirements :

Strong proficiency in advanced Excel (pivot, lookup, automation).

Understanding of risk taxonomy, KRI development, control testing, and incident analysis.

Ability to perform data validation and data interpretation to support accurate risk reporting.

Basic understanding of internal risk management systems or applications.

Ability to conduct trend analysis and scenario-based risk evaluation

Soft Competency Requirements :

Leadership: Leading cross-functional teams in identifying and mitigating risks.

Position Overview:

This role is responsible for developing, maintaining, and optimizing process control systems that support safe, reliable, and efficient mineral processing operations at the Round Mountain Gold Mine. Design, implement, and optimize control strategies across all plant circuits (Crushing, Grinding, Leaching) to enhance stability and metallurgical performance.

Configure, troubleshoot, and support DCS, PLC, and HMI/SCADA platforms to ensure high system availability and operational reliability.

Develop and tune regulatory and advanced control loops to improve process throughput, mineral recovery, and reagent efficiency.

Partner with Metallurgy and Operations teams to identify process constraints and implement proactive automation solutions for risk mitigation.

Collaborate with the Maintenance Superintendent to support instrumentation reliability, hardware integrity, and control network performance.

Provide high-level technical support and conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for complex process upsets or control system failures.

Lead automation-related capital projects, including functional specifications, FAT/SAT documentation, and commissioning for continuous improvement.

Qualifications:

Minimum Senior High School (SMA/SMK) qualification.

5–8 years of experience in process control or automation within mineral processing, mining, or heavy industrial environments.

Familiarity with CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management System).

Hands-on experience with DCS and/or PLC platforms commonly used in mining operations (e.g., Honeywell, ABB, Emerson, Rockwell).

Strong understanding of mineral processing unit operations and their specific control requirements.

Expertise in control loop tuning, alarm management, and control system troubleshooting.

Experience using process data analysis and visualization tools (e.g., Wonderware, PI System, or equivalent historians).

Instrumentation fundamentals, including flow, level, pressure, density, and analytical measurements.

Familiarity with Advanced Process Control (APC) concepts is preferre

title: Process Engineer
job_description:
Role Summary

The Process Engineer is responsible for analyzing, developing, and improving production processes to ensure smooth production planning and execution, achievement of PPC output targets, as well as cost efficiency, quality, and productivity through continuous improvement programs at the Bitung Plant.




Key Responsibilities

A. Support SPV PPC (Production Planning & Control)

Analyze production process data (cycle time, machine capacity, manpower, yield, downtime).

Provide technical input to SPV PPC regarding:

Actual line/machine capacity

Process bottlenecks

Line balancing and manpower optimization

Support the preparation and evaluation of:

Process routing

Standard production time

Daily/weekly production capacity

Identify gaps between production planning and actual results, and propose technical countermeasures.

Coordinate with PPC, production, maintenance, and quality teams to ensure production schedules are feasible and stable.

B. Technical Analysis & Documentation

Develop and update:

Process flow

Standard cycle time

Capacity calculations

Provide periodic process performance reports to management.

Support internal audits related to manufacturing processes and improvement initiatives.

C. Collaboration & Operational Support

Coordinate with:

Production

PPC

Maintenance

Quality

Provide technical support when process issues occur on the production line.

Participate in NPI (New Product Introduction) from a process readiness perspective when required.

Qualifications

Diploma (D3/D4) or Bachelor’s Degree (S1) in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or equivalent

Minimum 2–5 years of experience as a Process Engineer / Industrial Engineer (factory/manufacturing environment)

Experience supporting PPC or production planning is an advantage

Strong understanding of:

Manufacturing processes

Capacity planning & line balancing

Time study & productivity

Proficient in improvement tools (Lean, Kaizen, 5 Why, Fishbone)

Advanced skills in Microsoft Excel (data analysis & reporting)

Analytical thinking & problem-solving

Strong communication and cross-functional coordination

Continuous improvement mindset & willingness to learn

Willingness to work in a production environment (shopfloor-oriented)

title: EV Charging Engineer
job_description:
Requirements, Roles, and Responsibilities

1. Core Requirements

1.1 Electrical and Power Systems

• Understanding of single-phase and three-phase systems (up to 380V)

• Knowledge of protection systems (MCB, MCCB, SPD, grounding)

• Familiarity with electrical components (contactors, relays, CTs, power meters)

• Load calculation and power distribution

• Panel wiring experience

For DC Charging:

• Understanding of rectification (AC to DC conversion)

• High-voltage DC systems (200V–1000V)

• High-voltage safety practices

1.2 EV Charging Fundamentals

• Charging standards: Type 2 (AC), CCS2 (DC)

• Charging modes: Mode 2, Mode 3 (AC), Mode 4 (DC)

• Control Pilot (CP) signaling using PWM

• Proximity Pilot (PP) functionality

1.3 Communication and Protocols

• OCPP (Open Charge Point Protocol), especially version 1.6 and 2.0.1

• Modbus (RTU/TCP)

• Basic networking (IP addressing, subnetting, routing)

• API and HTTP integration

1.4 Embedded Systems

• Experience with PLCs or embedded systems ()

• GPIO and analog signal processing

• Data acquisition systems

2. Job Description

2.2 Installation and Commissioning

• Install EV charging stations (AC and DC)

• Perform electrical and communication wiring

• Configure network connectivity (LAN, SIM)

• Connect chargers to backend systems via OCPP

2.3 Testing and Troubleshooting

• Perform functional testing (charging start/stop)

• Diagnose issues such as CP errors, communication loss, and electrical faults

• Identify and resolve system failures

2.4 Integration and Monitoring

• Integrate EV chargers into monitoring platforms

• Develop dashboards for energy usage and charger status

• Use systems like SCADA, Node-RED, or cloud platforms

2.5 Maintenance and Support

• Conduct preventive maintenance

• Perform firmware updates

• Provide remote and on-site troubleshooting

3. Advanced Skills

3.1 DC Fast Charging Systems

• Power modules and rectifier stacks

• CAN communication with electric vehicles

• Thermal management systems

3.2 Backend and Cloud Systems

• OCPP server setup and management

• Cloud integration and database handling

• Data analytics and reporting

3.3 Safety and Standards

• IEC 61851 (EV charging systems)

• IEC 62196 (connectors)

• RCD Type B and surge protection

4. Soft Skills

• Strong problem-solving abilities

• Effective communication with clients and stakeholders

• Technical documentation (reports, installation reports, handover documents)

5. Conclusion

An EV Charging Engineer plays a critical role in the transition to electric mobility by ensuring reliable, safe, and efficient charging infrastructure. The role requires a strong combination of electrical expertise, communication protocols, and real-world field experience.

Are you a Java expert who can spot a flawed abstraction from across a codebase? Large-scale language models are evolving from clever chatbots into engines of real scientific and engineering progress. A bachelor's, master's, or PhD in computer science, software engineering, or a closely related field is a strong signal. The ability to clearly articulate why a solution is wrong or weak, not just that it is, matters as much as the technical depth.

title: Mobile Security Engineer
job_description:
About the job

The Product lock analyst - Android security is responsible for testing and helping maintain PayJoy's proprietary device locking technology against various bypass methods and tools, after every OS Over-The-Air (OTA) update, any update to our lock technology itself and any update to the in-market tools.

Responsibilities

Proactively and systematically test device locking mechanism on a diverse range of Android devices and OS versions following every OTA update.
Conduct thorough, periodic testing of the lock after every update or modification to the PayJoy lock technology. 
Actively research, identify, acquire, and utilize existing and emerging lock-breaking tools, software, hardware techniques, and methodologies (e.g., factory reset exploits, bootloader vulnerabilities, ADB exploits, custom ROM flashing, FRP bypass tools) to attempt to bypass the PayJoy lock.
Develop, maintain, and execute comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test scenarios specifically focused on lock security, bypass attempts, and anti-tampering features.
Simulate various attack vectors and user behaviors that could lead to a lock bypass.
Document all testing activities, methodologies, findings, discovered vulnerabilities, and precise steps to reproduce in a clear, concise, and actionable manner using our bug tracking system (e.g., JIRA).
Collaborate closely with Android developers, security engineers, and product managers to report vulnerabilities, discuss root causes, propose mitigation strategies, and verify the effectiveness of fixes.
Provide detailed reports on test execution, vulnerability status, and overall lock security posture.
Stay continuously updated on the latest Android security vulnerabilities, platform changes, rooting techniques, bootloader unlocking methods, custom firmware, and new bypass tools/techniques relevant to device locking mechanisms.
Maintain and manage a lab environment with various Android devices, testing tools, and necessary infrastructure.

 

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
3+ years of experience in Quality Assurance, with at least 1-2 years specifically focused on mobile application testing on the Android platform, proven hands-on experience and a strong curiosity for attempting to bypass software-based locks, security mechanisms, or device restrictions.
Strong understanding of the Android OS architecture, including bootloader, recovery mode, ADB (Android Debug Bridge), fastboot, system partitions, and security features.
Familiarity with common Android rooting techniques, custom ROMs (e.g., LineageOS), and tools used for device modification (e.g., Magisk, Xposed Framework – for understanding potential attack vectors).
Experience with Android debugging tools (e.g., Android Studio, Logcat, Wireshark/tcpdump for network analysis if relevant).
Meticulous attention to detail, strong analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document technical issues clearly and effectively.
Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and take ownership of assigned tasks in a fast-paced environment.

title: Quality Engineer
job_description:
Tanggung Jawab Utama

1. Perencanaan dan Persiapan Mutu (Pre-Construction)

Menyusun RMK (Rencana Mutu Kontrak): Membuat dokumen rencana mutu proyek (Project Quality Plan) yang mengacu pada Spesifikasi Umum Bina Marga

Pembuatan JMF & JMD: Bertanggung jawab penuh atas pembuatan Job Mix Design (JMD) dan Job Mix Formula (JMF) untuk aspal (AC-WC, AC-BC) dan beton.

Approval Material: Mengajukan persetujuan sumber material (Quarry) kepada Konsultan Pengawas dan Owner (Dinas PU/Balai). Mengingat di Jayapura, memastikan kualitas aggregate dari quarry lokal atau material didatangkan dari luar (misal: Palu/Sulawesi) sesuai spek sangat vital.

Kalibrasi Alat: Memastikan seluruh peralatan laboratorium dan peralatan batching plant atau AMP (Asphalt Mixing Plant) sudah terkalibrasi dan layak pakai.

2. Pengendalian Material Masuk (Incoming Material Control)

Inspeksi Bahan Baku: Melakukan pengecekan rutin terhadap material yang masuk ke stockpile (aspal cair, semen, agregat kasar/halus).

Uji Kualitas Rutin: Melakukan tes abrasi, kelekatan aspal, berat jenis, dan gradasi secara berkala untuk memastikan material dari quarry tetap konsisten.

3. Pengendalian Proses di Lapangan (Process Control)

Persetujuan Izin Kerja (Request for Work): Memverifikasi kesiapan lapangan sebelum pekerjaan dimulai (cek kebersihan, tack coat/prime coat, kesiapan alat).

Monitoring Suhu & Hamparan: Mengawasi suhu aspal saat di AMP, saat tiba di lokasi (dump truck), dan saat penghamparan (laying) agar sesuai JMF.

Pengawasan Pemadatan: Memastikan jumlah passing (lintasan) alat berat sesuai dengan trial section yang sudah disepakati.

Drainase & Bahu Jalan: Memastikan mutu beton untuk saluran drainase dan material timbunan bahu jalan sesuai spesifikasi.

4. Pengujian dan Laboratorium (Testing & Lab)

Manajemen Laboratorium: Memimpin teknisi lab dalam pelaksanaan tes harian.

Pengujian Lapangan: Mengawasi pelaksanaan Sand Cone Test (kepadatan tanah), Core Drill (ketebalan aspal), dan tes ekstraksi aspal (kadar aspal).

Trial Section: Memimpin pelaksanaan percobaan penghamparan (trial) sebelum pekerjaan utama dimulai.

5. Administrasi dan Pelaporan (Documentation)

Laporan Harian & Bulanan: Menyusun laporan Quality Control (QC) harian, mingguan, dan bulanan.

Back-Up Data Quality: Menyusun kelengkapan data kualitas (hasil tes lab, foto dokumentasi, request) sebagai syarat penagihan termin (MC - Monthly Certificate).

Penanganan NCR (Non-Conformance Report): Jika ada pekerjaan yang tidak lulus tes (misal: aspal kurang tebal atau beton retak), QE wajib menganalisis penyebabnya dan mengusulkan metode perbaikan (corrective action) kepada Project Manager.




Kualifikasi yang Dibutuhkan

Pendidikan: Minimal S1 Teknik Sipil, D3/D4 Sipil diperbolehkan jika memiliki pengalaman lapangan yang sangat kuat.

Sertifikasi Kompetensi (SKK/SKA): Wajib memiliki SKK (Sertifikat Kompetensi Kerja) Konstruksi yang masih aktif.

Jenjang: Minimal Ahli Muda (Jenjang 7) atau Ahli Madya (Jenjang 8).

Bidang: Teknik Jalan atau Ahli Material Jalan.

Pengalaman Minimal 3–5 tahun pengalaman kerja di posisi yang relevan (Quality Control/Quality Engineer).

Memiliki pengalaman spesifik pada proyek jalan aspal (Hotmix).

Diutamakan yang pernah menangani proyek Preservasi/Rehabilitasi Jalan

Mampu membuat dan menghitung Job Mix Formula (JMF) untuk aspal (AC-WC, AC-BC) dan beton.

Mampu mengoperasikan alat-alat laboratorium sipil dan memimpin teknisi lab.

Menguasai prosedur tes lapangan: Sand Cone (kepadatan tanah), Core Drill (ketebalan), Slump Test, ekstraksi aspal, dan Marshall Test.

Software: Mahir menggunakan Microsoft Excel (untuk laporan Back-Up Data Quantity & Quality) dan AutoCAD (untuk gambar kerja sederhana/sketsa titik kerusakan).

Tanggung Jawab Utama


Melakukan inspeksi visual dan pengujian produk secara menyeluruh di berbagai tahap produksi untuk memastikan kesesuaian dengan standar kualitas yang telah ditetapkan.

Memelihara dokumentasi lengkap hasil pengujian, laporan inspeksi, dan catatan kualitas sesuai dengan prosedur perusahaan.

Melakukan audit internal untuk memverifikasi kepatuhan terhadap standar kualitas dan regulasi yang berlaku.

Memberikan rekomendasi untuk peningkatan proses dan efisiensi operasional berdasarkan data dan analisis kualitas.

Program insentif kinerja berbasis pencapaian target kualitas.

Kami adalah perusahaan manufaktur terkemuka di industri logistik yang berkomitmen untuk menghadirkan produk berkualitas tinggi kepada pelanggan kami di seluruh dunia. Kami percaya bahwa kualitas adalah jantung dari kesuksesan bisnis kami, dan setiap anggota tim memiliki peran penting dalam mencapai visi ini. Budaya kerja kami mendorong kolaborasi, pembelajaran berkelanjutan, dan pengembangan profesional bagi setiap karyawan. Kami tidak hanya memproduksi produk; kami membangun kepercayaan dan hubungan jangka panjang dengan semua pemangku kepentingan kami.

Lamar Sekarang
Jika Anda memiliki passion untuk kualitas dan ingin berkontribusi pada tim yang berdedikasi, kami mengundang Anda untuk melamar sekarang. Bergabunglah dengan kami dan jadilah bagian dari perjalanan menuju keunggulan operasional dan inovasi berkelanjutan dalam industri manufaktur.

Contracting Empire is a marketing agency that works exclusively with high-ticket contractors in the US. We build websites, SEO, local SEO, and paid media systems that move the needle for our clients. We're not a checkbox agency, and we're not looking for checkbox people.

You make decisions based on data, not gut feeling.

You hold yourself to a high standard in everything you do, not just the parts people are watching.

You're genuinely invested in the success of your clients and your colleagues, not just your own output.

You know how to keep the team updated and ask the right questions without being policed.

You're comfortable talking to clients, shooting video reports, and keeping them in the loop because their results matter to you.

You see your work as more than just a paycheck.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

You'll own a portfolio of client accounts end-to-end. That means full visibility into what's working, what's not, and what needs to happen next — without being reminded.

Running Ahrefs audits, technical cleanups, and site maintenance (zombie pages, crawl issues, the works) without being asked twice

Monitoring GTmetrix, Search Console, and Analytics because you want to know, not because someone told you to check

Citation work, local SEO management via BrightLocal, and the repetitive-but-critical tasks that keep accounts healthy

Identifying constraints, bottlenecks, and growth opportunities across your accounts and acting on them

Keeping clients informed through video reports and direct communication — because you're invested in their success

What Makes You Stand Out

We don't want someone who checks tasks off a list and calls it a day. We want someone who digs deeper because this is genuinely something they care about.

You own outcomes, not tasks. You understand SEO and local SEO as a whole system, and you take full responsibility for what happens on your accounts. Agency experience is a must.

You see what others miss. You analyze data to find constraints and improvements and you act on them without being asked.

You think in solutions. Complex problems don't slow you down. You test hypotheses, adjust based on evidence, and keep moving.

You set your own bar. We don't want to tell you how to do your job. You should be able to tell us.

You never settle. Stagnation isn't in your vocabulary, and mediocrity isn't something you protect.

SEO: Google Search Console, Google Analytics, Ahrefs, BrightLocal, Screaming Frog

12 paid vacation days on top of public holidays, with more added based on seniority

Access to courses, training, and conferences as needed

Quantity Surveyor dan On-Site engineer bertanggung jawab untuk menghitung dan mengestimasi biaya proyek pembangunan, mulai dari material, tenaga kerja, hingga biaya lainnya. Menyiapkan Bill of Quantities (BoQ) atau Rencana Anggaran Biaya (RAB) yang detail.

Memastikan semua dokumen terkait biaya proyek terdokumentasi dengan baik.

Menyampaikan petunjuk teknis kepada seluruh tim pekerja.

Kemampuan analitis dan matematis yang kuat.

Pengetahuan tentang material, metode konstruksi, dan standar desain.

Menguasai software seperti Microsoft Excel.

Kemampuan komunikasi dan team-work yang baik.

Detail-oriented dan mampu bekerja di bawah tekanan.

Memiliki integritas tinggi, kejujuran, dan kemampuan manajemen waktu yang baik.

Background

UNDP is committed to achieving workforce diversity in terms of gender, nationality, and culture. Individuals from minority groups, indigenous groups and persons with disabilities are equally encouraged to apply. All applications will be treated with the strictest confidence. UNDP does not tolerate sexual exploitation and abuse, any kind of harassment, including sexual harassment, and discrimination. All selected candidates will, therefore, undergo rigorous reference and background checks. UNDP is the leading United Nations organization in fighting to end the injustice of poverty, inequality, and climate change. Working with our broad network of experts and partners in 170 countries, we help nations to build integrated, lasting solutions for people and planet. Learn more at undp.org or follow at @UNDP.

UNDP’s Support to Marine Plastic Litter Reduction and Waste Management

Marine debris remains a major environmental challenge in Indonesia, affecting marine ecosystems, public health, fisheries, tourism, and the broader economy. To address this issue, the Government of Indonesia issued Presidential Regulation No. 83/2018 on the National Action Plan on Marine Debris (RAN PSL), targeting a 70% reduction in marine debris by 2025 through coordinated actions across 22 ministries and agencies under the National Coordination Team on Marine Debris (TKN PSL).

Building on the progress of the National Action Plan and recognizing the need for stronger waste governance beyond 2025, the Government of Indonesia is currently discussing the revision and potential integration of Presidential Regulation No. 83/2018 on Marine Debris Management and Presidential Regulation No. 97/2017 on the National Policy and Strategy for Household Waste Management (Jakstranas). This effort aims to strengthen a more integrated waste management framework that addresses waste reduction, handling, and leakage prevention from source to sea. The national commitment is further reinforced through the National Medium-Term Development Plan (RPJMN) 2025–2029, which targets 100% waste management coverage and zero plastic leakage by 2029.

UNDP Indonesia, through the Marine Plastic Litter Reduction Acceleration Secretariat Project, supports the Government of Indonesia in implementing the National Action Plan on Marine Debris by strengthening coordination under TKN PSL, improving monitoring and reporting systems, and supporting policy development including updated regulatory frameworks for waste management beyond 2025. In addition, UNDP promotes innovative river waste management approaches, recognizing that rivers are a major pathway for land-based waste entering the ocean. These efforts aim to strengthen data systems, enhance stakeholder collaboration, and accelerate progress toward Indonesia’s marine plastic reduction and sustainable waste management targets.

Duties And Responsibilities

The Solid Waste Management Analyst will have the responsibility:

The Solid Waste Management Analyst will report directly to the Project Manager of the Marine Plastic Litter Reduction Acceleration Secretariat Project and work in close coordination with relevant government counterparts, implementing partners, and key stakeholders at national and sub-national levels.

The incumbent will work closely with the UNDP Country Office (CO) programme and operations teams to ensure technical quality assurance, compliance with UNDP rules and regulations, and effective delivery of project outputs. The incumbent will provide technical inputs to project planning, implementation, monitoring, and reporting processes, ensuring alignment with project objectives and applicable environmental and social safeguards.

To provide technical design and strategic guidance for integrated waste management interventions, focusing on the achievement of the following results:


Development, review, and refinement of the strategies for waste reduction, collection, segregation, recycling, treatment, and final disposal in alignment with Indonesia’s National Waste Management Policy, the Circular Economy Roadmap, and project objectives.
Provision of the technical recommendations to enhance efficiency, cost-effectiveness, environmental sustainability, and climate benefits of waste management systems at community and municipal levels.
Provision of the technical advisory support on environmentally sound treatment options, including composting, material recovery facilities (MRFs), refuse-derived fuel (RDF), and waste-to-energy (WtE) solutions, ensuring technical feasibility, financial viability, and regulatory compliance.
Effective support to the development of technical guidelines and standard operating procedures (SOPs) for segregation, recycling, residual waste treatment, landfill management, and WtE operations implemented under the project.
Ensuring that all technical designs and interventions comply with UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (SES) and relevant national regulations.



To Design And Implement The Capacity Building Programme For Project Partners And Stakeholders, Focusing On The Achievement Of The Following Results


Development of the technical training modules for multi-stakeholder, including waste workers, and informal sector actors on integrated solid waste management, recycling technologies, Waste to Energy (WtE) concepts, and Gender Equality, Disability and Social Inclusion (GEDSI) principles.
Provision on-the-job mentoring and technical coaching to enhance institutional and operational capacity for sustainable and inclusive waste management practices.
Promoting gender-responsive, inclusive, and safe working environments across project-supported activities.
Ensuring that capacity-building initiatives contribute to local ownership, institutional strengthening, and long-term sustainability of interventions.



To support innovation, piloting, and technical oversight of project implementation, focusing on the achievement of the following results:


Identification potential innovation approach and design the piloting of innovative practices or technologies that reduce plastic leakage, improve resource recovery, and strengthen circular economy outcomes, including climate-friendly treatment options.
Provision of technical oversight and quality assurance during implementation to ensure consistency with project standards, environmental safeguards, and expected results.



Support knowledge generation, lesson learning, documentation, and reporting, focusing on the achievement of the following results:


Consolidate field findings, technical progress, and recommendations into periodic progress reports and a final technical report for UNDP and project partners.
Capture and document lessons learned and good practices during project implementation to inform ongoing and future initiatives.
Contribute to the preparation of knowledge products, such as technical briefs, case studies, and presentations on waste management and circular economy practices.
Support advocacy, communication, and outreach efforts to raise awareness of project results, innovations, and impacts.
Facilitate and organize training sessions and capacity-building activities for project staff and partners to strengthen technical and operational competencies.
Participate in meetings, workshops, and communities of practice to share insights and strengthen collaboration across stakeholders.
Ensure all documentation and reporting highlight environmental, social, and gender outcomes in line with project priorities.
Perform any other duties related to project monitoring, evaluation, and knowledge management as required.
Effective contribution to learning and knowledge sharing in gender analysis and gender mainstreaming.



The incumbent of the position should avoid any kind of discriminatory behaviour including gender discrimination and ensure that


Human rights and gender equality is prioritized as an ethical principle within all actions;
Activities are designed and implemented in accordance with “Social and Environmental Standards of UNDP”;
Any kind of diversity based on ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, disability, religion, class, gender are respected within all implementations including data production;

Inclusive approach is reflected within all actions and implementations, in that sense an enabling and accessible setup in various senses such as disability gender language barrier is created;

title: Senior Product Manager - Gen AI and Conversational Platforms
job_description:
About the job

Who We Are

We are an organisation that exists to drive progress. That's the “red thread” that connects everyone at The Economist Group (TEG). Our businesses share a devotion to innovation, independence and rigour in their fields of expertise. We empower people to understand and tackle the critical challenges and changes facing the world. Our analytical rigour, global expertise and evidence-based insights enable individuals and organisations to make sense of these shifts and chart a course through them.

We deliver analysis and insights in many formats to subscribers and clients in 170 countries through our four businesses, The Economist, Economist Impact, Economist Intelligence and Economist Education, which uphold our global reputation for excellence and integrity.

As new technologies reshape how people access information, our journalism is increasingly discovered, interpreted and consumed through AI-native and conversational platforms. Large language models, agent frameworks and conversational interfaces are rapidly becoming primary gateways to knowledge, acting as intermediaries between audiences and authoritative sources.

We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to own The Economist’s approach to Gen AI and conversational platforms - ensuring that when AI systems surface, summarise or reason over our journalism, they do so accurately, responsibly and in line with our editorial standards.

The role

The Senior Product Manager for Gen AI & Conversational Platforms owns how The Economist is represented, queried and interpreted across third-party AI-native and conversational environments.

This role treats AI ecosystems, such as LLM-based assistants, agent-based systems and AI-driven discovery environments, as platforms in their own right - each with distinct product dynamics, technical requirements and success metrics.

Role

A core focus of the role is ownership of LLM connector and retrieval experiences. This includes defining and evolving the schemas, interfaces and protocols that allow AI systems to:


Query The Economist’s content accurately 
Retrieve the correct material with appropriate context 
Ground responses in authoritative sources
Attribute and cite journalism clearly and consistently 


You will work on capabilities analogous to MCP-style integrations, tool and function calling, retrieval pipelines, grounding and citation mechanisms, and agent-facing content interfaces.

This role focuses on representation, fidelity and optimisation at the boundary between our content and external AI systems.

You will report to the Principal Product Manager for Web, Newsletters & Conversational Platforms, and work closely with Search & Discovery, Web, App, Engineering, Data Science and Editorial teams.

Responsibilities


Own the vision and roadmap for Gen AI and conversational platforms as distribution and interpretation environments. 
Define how The Economist’s journalism should be queried, retrieved, grounded, cited and represented by LLMs and agent-based systems. 
Lead product strategy for LLM connector and retrieval integrations, including schemas, APIs, tools, metadata and grounding mechanisms. 
Partner closely with engineering and data science on retrieval pipelines, content representations, evaluation approaches and optimisation strategies. 
Partner closely with Marketing and SEO specialists for how we want our brand to appear on these platforms, and what is/is not paywalled. 
Ensure AI systems can reliably distinguish authoritative content, context, timeliness and editorial intent. 
Define standards for fidelity, attribution, transparency and trust in AI-mediated representations of our journalism. 
Monitor emerging AI platforms, protocols and standards (e.g. new agent frameworks, connector models, distribution patterns), identifying opportunities and risks. 
Work with Web and App teams to ensure products are well-optimised for AI-driven discovery, referral and interpretation. 
Define and track success metrics related to accuracy, grounding quality, authority, reach and consistency of representation.
Act as an internal expert on AI platform dynamics, advising editorial, legal, commercial and product stakeholders. 


Who You Are


Experience owning AI-powered, platform or ecosystem-facing products, particularly where third-party systems act as intermediaries. 
Strong understanding of how LLMs retrieve, reason over and present content, including retrieval-augmented generation concepts. 
Comfort working on technically complex product areas involving APIs, schemas, metadata, evaluation and system boundaries. 
Ability to partner effectively with engineers and data scientists on ambiguous, evolving problems. 
Sound judgement around responsible AI, editorial integrity and risk management. 
Clear communicator able to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. 


Domain knowledge 


Large language model ecosystems, conversational agents and agent frameworks.
Content retrieval, grounding, citation and attribution mechanisms.
Connector models, tool/function calling and AI-facing interfaces.
Platform dynamics and third-party integrations. 
Responsible AI considerations in content-rich environments. 
Enthusiasm for The Economist’s mission, journalism and editorial values.


Working Arrangements

The majority of our roles operate on a hybrid working pattern, with 3+ days office attendance required.

AI usage for your application

We are an innovative organisation that encourages the use of technology. We recognise that candidates may utilise AI tools to support with their job application process. However, it is essential that all information you provide truthfully and accurately reflects your own experience, skills, and qualifications.

What We Offer

Our benefits package is designed to support your wellbeing, growth, and work-life balance. It includes a highly competitive pension or 401(k) plan, private health insurance, and 24/7 access to counselling and wellbeing resources through our Employee Assistance Program.

We also offer a range of lifestyle benefits, including our Work From Anywhere program, which allows you to work from any location where you have the legal right to do so for up to 25 days per year. In addition, we provide generous annual and parental leave, as well as dedicated days off for volunteering and even for moving home.

You will also be given free access to all The Economist content, including an online subscription, our range of apps, podcasts and more.

Advanced ability to write cinematic prompts specifying motion, mood, duration, camera behaviour, and stylistic references to reliably achieve intended results.

Core Iteration & QC

Systematic approach to testing prompt variations, evaluating outputs against a brief, and refining for consistency, quality, and brand alignment.

Plus Multi-modal Workflow

Background in live-action filmmaking, photography, or commercial production

Familiarity with sound design and music curation to complement visual work

Fluent in English for prompt generation

You think like a director first, a technologist second

You treat AI tools as a cinematographer treats a camera — with precision and intention, not randomness

You stay ahead of the curve: you know what dropped on Higgsfield last week and have already tested it

title: AI-Growth Engineer (10X Marketer)

About the job

AI-Growth Engineer

Smartven — Bangun mesin pemasaran yang bekerja 24/7, tanpa tim besar.




---




MASALAH NYATA YANG HARUS KAMU SELESAIKAN




Kami punya 300+ smart vending machines aktif di seluruh Indonesia. Ratusan entrepreneur yang jadi klien. Tapi cara kita dapat leads baru sampai hari ini? Masih manual. Masih 1-on-1. Masih bergantung pada orang




Itu harus berubah.




Target kami: 10.000 klien di 2036. Dengan kecepatan sekarang, kita tidak akan sampai ke sana. Kita butuh sistem yang bisa generate, nurture, dan qualify leads—bahkan saat tim kita tidur.




Itulah yang akan kamu bangun.




Bukan campaign. Bukan social media calendar. Sebuah automated growth engine yang jadi fondasi ekspansi Smartven ke seluruh Asia Tenggara.




Kalau kamu tipe yang lebih puas melihat workflow automation berjalan mulus daripada viral post, keep reading.




---




PERAN INI: APA YANG SEBENARNYA KAMU KERJAKAN




1. Bangun Lead Generation Engine

Tugas utama: sistem kita harus bisa dapat 50+ qualified leads per minggu—tanpa manusia yang aktif mengejar satu per satu.




Yang perlu kamu rancang dan build:




Funnel: LinkedIn outreach → CRM entry → Email nurture → WhatsApp follow-up (all automated)
Trigger-based workflows: lead masuk → sistem langsung qualify → sales hanya handle yang sudah warm
Integration layer: connect tools yang kita pakai (HubSpot/Notion, WhatsApp Business API, Make/n8n) jadi satu ekosistem

Success metric Bulan 6: 50+ qualified leads/minggu, 80% dihasilkan sistem tanpa intervensi manual.




2. AI-Powered Content & Outreach




Bukan sekadar pakai ChatGPT untuk nulis caption. Kita bicara tentang:

Bangun content pipeline pakai AI: landing page, email sequences, LinkedIn outreach, SMS blast — semua bisa di-deploy sales dalam 10 detik
Personalisasi massal: pesan yang terasa personal untuk setiap segmen (F&B brand, retail chain, MSME owner) tapi dihasilkan sistem
SEO + edukasi market: artikel yang menjawab pertanyaan "apa itu vending machine bisnis?" sebelum prospect bahkan sadar mereka butuh kita

Success metric Bulan 6: Open rate email 65%+, reply rate 12%+.




3. Growth Dashboard & Intelligence




Saat ini data kita tersebar: Google Sheets, CRM terpisah, laporan manual. Kamu akan:

Konsolidasi semua data ke satu dashboard (leads, conversion rate, CAC, LTV, pipeline)
Buat weekly report yang menjawab: "Dari mana leads terbaik datang? Apa yang mati? Apa yang harus di-double down?"
Ubah keputusan tim dari gut feeling jadi data-driven

Success metric Bulan 6: Leadership dan sales pakai dashboard ini setiap hari—bukan sekadar pajangan.




---

Yang kamu bawa:




Proven experience dengan marketing automation platform (Make, n8n, Zapier, HubSpot, atau equivalent)
Comfortable dengan API logic: webhooks, triggers, conditional workflows—bukan coding, tapi harus natural
CRM architecture: paham custom fields, pipeline stages, data hygiene
AI tools untuk business (bukan cuma copywriting)
Bisa baca + interpret data: conversion rate, CAC, LTV, payback period




Nice to have:

WhatsApp Business API integration experience
Basic SEO (keyword research, on-page)
E-commerce funnel (Shopify, WooCommerce)




---




GET IT / WANT IT / CAPABLE




Get It:

Kamu paham Smartven bukan jual mesin—kami jual business enablement. Setiap leads yang datang adalah calon entrepreneur yang butuh kepastian, edukasi, dan trust sebelum commit. Sistem yang kamu bangun harus terasa personal dan manusiawi, bukan spammy.




Want It:

Kamu frustrasi dengan marketing yang manual, lambat, dan tidak scalable. Kamu ingin build once, run forever. Kamu excited lebih lihat workflow berjalan otomatis daripada dapat pujian atas satu campaign.




Capable:




2+ tahun di growth marketing, marketing ops, atau B2B growth (SaaS, marketplace, atau e-commerce)
Punya track record: bukan "pernah pakai Zapier" tapi "saya bangun sistem X yang generate Y leads per bulan"
Nyaman kerja lintas fungsi: ngobrol teknikal dengan CTO, kasih brief ke sales, report ke CEO
Data-literate: kamu baca angka untuk buat keputusan, bukan validasi opini




---




SCORECARD + PROBATION (3 Bulan Pertama)




Bulan 1 — Audit & Quick Wins (No pressure)

Pelajari semua lead gen sources yang ada sekarang
Audit gaps: mana yang manual, mana yang bisa diautomasi
Deliver: 2 quick wins yang bisa langsung impact pipeline




Bulan 2–3 — Build & Prove

Build end-to-end funnel pertama: LinkedIn → CRM → Email nurture sequence
Target: 20+ qualified leads/minggu dari sistem
Build draft growth dashboard




Kalau kamu hit targets: Full contract + salary review

Kalau tidak: Percakapan jujur—ada opsi pivot ke role lain, atau exit dengan severance

Yang pasti: Kamu dapat feedback setiap minggu. Tidak ada kejutan di bulan ke-3.




---




KOMPENSASI

Base Salary: IDR 8M–12M/bulan (depends on track record)

Performance Bonus (per kuartal):

Sistem generate 50+ leads/minggu → +IDR 2M–4M
Email open rate 65%+ → +IDR 1M–2M
Dashboard dipakai aktif tim → +IDR 1M–2M

Total potential Tahun 1: IDR 10M–15M/bulan rata-rata

Tahun 2+: Head of Growth — salary naik + equity conversation terbuka




Culture: Flat hierarchy. Feedback mingguan. Bukan perusahaan besar—kamu ownership atas pekerjaan kamu, bukan sekadar executioner brief dari atasan.




---




HONEST EXPECTATIONS




Data kita saat ini berantakan. Kamu akan spend waktu di data cleaning sebelum bisa mulai analisis.
Pasar Indonesia masih edukasi. Sebagian prospect belum pernah dengar "marketing automation"—sistem kamu harus bridge gap itu.
Funnel pertama mungkin tidak langsung berhasil. Iterasi adalah bagian dari pekerjaan.
Kita bergerak cepat. Prioritas bisa berubah tiap minggu berdasarkan feedback pasar.
Ini bukan role Fortune 500. Tidak ada marketing department besar, tidak ada agency support. Kamu adalah sistemnya.




---

CARA APPLY (Kami Filter Action-Takers)

Kami tidak minta resume dulu. Kami minta bukti kamu bisa kerja.




Kamu akan diminta Kirim 2 hal ini bila shortlisted:

1. Voice note 3 menit (rekam lewat HP):

Perkenalan singkat: nama, background, terbesar yang pernah kamu build
Jawab: Kenapa Smartven? Kenapa sekarang?

2. Satu paragraf (tulisan):

Describe 1 automation funnel yang pernah kamu bangun: tools yang dipakai, masalah yang dipecahkan, dan hasilnya dalam angka




Kenapa dua hal ini? Voice note menunjukkan energy dan komunikasi. Paragraf tulisan membuktikan kamu bisa think sistematis dan ukur hasil—bukan cuma bicara tentang marketing.




Timeline: Kami putuskan maximum dalam 1 minggu ini. Lamar Senin → keputusan Jumat.




---

APPLY KALAU:

Punya 2+ funnels yang proven generate leads (bukan sekadar "pernah setup Zapier")
Excited bangun sistem yang scalable dari 300 ke 10.000 klien
Suka ambiguity—dan solve it dengan data, bukan asumsi
Ingin ownership penuh, bukan sekadar eksekusi brief




JANGAN APPLY KALAU:

Butuh struktur marketing department yang established
Prefer perfect data sebelum buat keputusan
Tidak nyaman dengan feedback mingguan
Kamu think "good marketing" = konten yang aesthetically pleasing




Ready?

Kami excited ketemu builder yang serius.

 Human Development;

Bachelor’s degree in Geotechnical, Civil, or Geological Engineering (Master’s degree and Indonesian professional certification preferred).

Minimum 3 years of experience as a Geotechnical Engineer, with hands-on expertise in slope stability analysis and pile foundation design, preferably in Indonesian projects and familiar with local geological conditions and construction practices.

Proficient in geotechnical software (GeoStudio/Slope W, Plaxis 2D/3D, Lpile) with a strong understanding of slope stability, pile design principles, and relevant calculation methods, able to independently perform simulations and technical calculations.

title: Drafter Engineering Panel Listrik
job_description:
Seorang Drafter Engineering Panel Listrik bertanggung jawab untuk mentransformasikan konsep desain teknis dari Engineer menjadi gambar kerja (shop drawing) yang akurat dan detail. Fokus utamanya adalah memastikan instruksi desain dapat dipahami dengan mudah oleh tim produksi dan instalasi lapangan, serta sesuai dengan standar kelistrikan yang berlaku.

Tugas & Tanggung Jawab Utama

1. Pengembangan Gambar Teknis

Membuat Gambar Layout Panel: Menyusun tata letak komponen di dalam panel (komponen mounting) dan tampak depan (pintu panel) secara presisi menggunakan software AutoCAD atau EPLAN.

Menyusun Wiring Diagram: Membuat skema pengkabelan (schematic diagram) yang mencakup sistem kontrol (PLC/Relay) dan sistem daya (power circuit).

SLD: Menggambar diagram garis tunggal yang merepresentasikan alur distribusi listrik dari sumber utama ke beban.

Detailed Drawing: Membuat detail potongan busbar, plat mounting, dan lubang ventilasi untuk keperluan fabrikasi box panel.

2. Administrasi & Dokumentasi Material

Penyusunan Bill of Materials (BOM): Mengidentifikasi dan mendata spesifikasi serta jumlah komponen yang digunakan dalam gambar untuk kebutuhan pengadaan (procurement).

Manajemen Revisi Gambar: Mencatat dan memperbarui setiap perubahan desain (as-built drawing) setelah proses perakitan atau instalasi selesai.

Dokumentasi Teknis: Memastikan semua file gambar tersimpan dengan sistem penomoran yang rapi sesuai standar perusahaan untuk mempermudah pelacakan data.

3. Koordinasi & Pengawasan Teknis

Asistensi Produksi: Memberikan penjelasan teknis kepada tim perakit (wiring & mekanik) jika terdapat ketidakjelasan pada gambar kerja.

Sinkronisasi Desain: Berkoordinasi dengan Project Engineer untuk memastikan desain panel sesuai dengan spesifikasi permintaan klien dan ketersediaan ruang di lokasi proyek.

Pengecekan Standar: Memastikan desain memenuhi standar keselamatan kelistrikan (seperti PUIL di Indonesia atau standar internasional IEC).

Kualifikasi yang Dibutuhkan

Pendidikan: Minimal SMK Teknik Elektro / Gambar Bangunan atau D3 Teknik Elektro/Mesin.

Keahlian Software:

Wajib menguasai AutoCAD (2D & 3D).

Nilai tambah jika menguasai software khusus panel seperti EPLAN, SolidWorks Electrical, atau AutoCAD Electrical.

Kompetensi Teknis:

Memahami simbol-simbol komponen listrik (MCB, Contactor, PLC, Inverter, dll).

Mampu membaca dan menerjemahkan skema elektrik ke dalam bentuk fisik panel.

Memahami teknik tekuk plat dan tata letak mekanis komponen.

Karakter Kerja: Teliti, disiplin terhadap deadline, dan mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun tim.

Output Kerja (Deliverables)

Shop Drawing (Gambar untuk produksi).

As-Built Drawing (Gambar final setelah terpasang).

Bill of Materials (Daftar kebutuhan barang).

Busbar Cutting List (Panduan pemotongan tembaga/busbar).

About the job

Company Description

At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.

Job Description

The Data Entry Coordinator role is a data entry level position. It is aligned to the International side of Advertising Intelligence. The International department monitors for adverts from over 80 different countries and as such, our department is resourced with linguists, covering over 40 different languages. Adverts are identified and monitored in the source country's language, the information for the client is then captured in English. This role therefore requires Fluent English, as well as native/fluent level in the Vietnamese language that is being advertised for.

Responsibilities


Identifying relevant advertising from the source language from a variety of media, including Television, Radio, Press and Digital platforms.
Monitoring adverts for content, including identifying and clipping adverts, cataloguing key details from the advert like brand product, headline, endline, description. Adverts are presented to you in their source language and the data you capture should be in English, clients will use this data to improve their own media campaigns and monitor competitor activity.
Ability to assist with other languages with similar properties (on a best endeavour basis).
Assisting with Scanning of publications and downloading of PDF’s, on request.
Assisting with Data-Loading of incoming work or Mapping of local products to global products using Portfolio taxonomy, on request.
Working on client driven requirements such as rework of TV versioning data, on request.
Working as part of a team to ensure all departmental deadlines are met..
Work to reach and exceed agreed targets for both productivity and quality to enable the team to meet all SLA agreements. 
Providing cover within the departments or other areas of the business as required.
Liaise with other departments within the company to ensure quality and consistency is maintained.
Make proper use of company systems.
Any other reasonable tasks required by the company at any given time.


Qualifications


Fluent in English and the expertise in Vietnamese Language is mandatory.
Additional language skills are always beneficial, please declare all languages and fluency levels
High focus on attention to detail
Delivery focused
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Excellent data entry skills
Good basic numeracy
Prior experience using Google suite - including Sheets, Gmail, Docs would be advantageous


Additional Information

Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

Excellent data entry skills

title: Front Office Manager
job_description:
About the job

With thousands of hotels in over 100 countries and territories, Hilton offers countless opportunities to delight. From an open door to a welcoming smile and an exceptional experience, we offer the millions of travellers who stay with us every year a welcome they will never forget. In addition to our flagship brand, Hilton Hotels & Resorts, the family of brands includes Waldorf Astoria, LXR, Conrad, Canopy, Curio Collection, DoubleTree, Hilton Garden Inn, Hampton and many others.

If you appreciate the impact global travel can have on the world, you may be just the person we are looking for to work as a Hilton Team Member. Because it’s with Hilton where we never forget the reason we're here: to delight our guests, Team Members, and owners alike.

The Front Office Manager is concerned with the strategic management of the Front Office department following Hilton brand standards, policies and procedures. This role is responsible for the operation of all Front Desk operations, the Transportation team, Concierge, and telephone service centre.

What will I be doing? 

As the Front Office Manager, you will be responsible for performing the following tasks to the highest standards:


 Maintain high customer service focus by approaching your job with the customers always in mind.
 Have a positive impact, taking personal responsibility and initiative to resolve issues, always clearly communicating with both customers and colleagues.
 Motivated and committed, approaching all tasks with enthusiasm and seizing opportunities to learn new skills or knowledge in order to improve your personal performance.
 Be flexible, responding quickly and positively to changing requirements including the performance of any tasks requested of you.
 Maintain high team focus by showing cooperation and support to colleagues in the pursuit of team goals.
 Contribute ideas and suggestions to enhance operational / environmental procedures in the hotel.
 Actively promote the services and facilities of Hilton hotels to guests and suppliers of the hotel.
 Actively seek verbal feedback from customers and team members at every opportunity.
 Agree and implement actions to make improvements to customer service.
 Positively dealing with and learn from customer complaints and comments with follow-up and feedback to the Director of Operations.
 Make sure all customer requests and queries are responded to promptly and effectively while assisting on the floor during peak periods each day.
 Be available to assist on duty in the hotels during any busy days or special events.
 Maintain a presence in the lobby setting the example for team members for guest service.
 Be proactive towards guests, assisting them with any reasonable requests, and training all team members to see these things before the guests ask.
 Have detailed knowledge of Hilton departmental standards, explaining the standards to the team and training each team member individually with specific job skills checklists that relate to their responsibilities.
 Assess team members’ performance against standards.
 Monitor standards through regular standards review checks.
 Develop action plans to address shortfalls in standards and identify shortfalls before they affect customer service.
 Implement and follow through with improvements identified.
 Demonstrate positive leadership characteristics which inspire team members to meet and exceed standards.
 Prepare rosters and job schedules for team members to meet business needs (taking into consideration internal activities, occupancy and external events, promotions etc.).
 Communicate effectively with Housekeeping, groups and tours about any in-house group holding catering events, ensuring direct liaison with group leaders upon arrival for special requests.
 Describe, assign and delegate duties and authority for the operation of the department at all times.
 Understand the situation in other departments and their implications for your own department.
 Plan ahead and ensure adequate resources are available.
 Coordinate with the Housekeeping department to ensure cleaning is followed-up, ensuring that follow-up procedures are maintained.
 Ensure that the shift is reviewed, handovers and briefings are carried out.
 Maintain in-depth technical knowledge and skills required for the job.
 Maintain guest histories to assist with returning guests.
 Establish good communication with the Housekeeping team.
 Attend and participate in regular operational and hotel meetings.
 Ensure that supplier liaison with the Purchasing team ensures maximum support with regards to sponsorship, marketing and pricing initiatives.
 Responsible for the maximization of room revenue and profit through commercial room management, ensuring a consistently high standard of customer service within the department.
 Make all decisions regarding overbooking the hotel on the same day, ensure all out bookings are carried out by members of the Management and that overbooking levels for future days will be monitored by the Revenue Manager.
 Understand the goals of the hotel and the department’s role in achieving it, communicating goals to the team.
 Ensure that daily operation is managed by the Guest Service Managers and Supervisors who are totally accountable for the profitability and service standards achieved.
 Sett and agree to departmental objectives for self and team.
 Represent the needs of the team to others in the hotel.
 Get members of the team to work co-operatively with others.
 Keep the team up to date on departmental, hotel and company activities through regular communication meetings and memos, including special events, promotions in the restaurants and bars.
 Be aware of potential highs and lows in the business.
 Create and implement sales promotions and team members incentives as per discussion with the Director of Operations.
 Assist the Marcom team with the preparation of event brochures.
 Assist with the annual marketing plan to establish a list of marketing activities in line with the annual business plan, supported by appropriate advertising and promotion budgets from suppliers with the support of the Revenue Manager and marcom team.
 Identify, communicate and act on potential sales leads.
 Participate in the development of the annual budget, developing short and long term financial operating plans.
 Use key monitors and financial targets to evaluate the department’s performance and make future plans.
 Analyze financial information that is provided via the payroll system and ONQ, to assist decision making.
 Complete regular financial and operating reports as required or requested by the Director of Operations.
 Forecast potential costs, review expenses on a monthly basis and implement actions for improvement, following the company’s control procedures.
 Communicate relevant financial information to the team.
 Analyze and explain any financial variance against plans.
 Set-up and maintain leave plans for the department.
 Monitor, control and minimize overtime for the department.
 Carry out seasonal inventory of operating equipment.
 Understand the quantity and quality of people needed to operate the department.
 Carry out selection interviews and make effective recruitment decisions based on skills and attitude.
 Ensure that new recruits have all relevant information before commencing employment.
 Plan and ensure that departmental orientation is carried out.
 Ensure standards trainings and assessments are carried out.
 Regularly review individual and team performance against objectives and provide feedback.
 Develop and implement department training plans to meet business needs.
 Carry out training programs for team members with the Training Manager and departmental trainers.
 Assist in the training of team members ensuring that they have the necessary skills to perform their duties with maximum efficiency.
 Review and evaluate all training activities.
 Carry out annual appraisals with all team members in accordance with legal and hotel guidelines and identify individual training needs.
 Provide relevant training to new team members.
 Introduce appropriate product knowledge courses for team members.
 Understand relevant Health & Safety (H&S) legislations and their implications on the operation of the department.
 Communicate to the team their responsibilities within H&S.
 Ensure that safe and healthy working practices are implemented at all times.
 Participate in community public relations for the hotel.

A Front Office Manager serving Hilton Brands is always working on behalf of our Guests and working with other Team Members. To successfully fill this role, you should maintain the attitude, behaviour, skills, and values that follow:


 Good communication, organization and coordination skills.
 Good team player.
 Responsible and self-motivated.
 Patient, responsible and proactive in dealing with problems.
 Able to maintain excellent relations with team members.
 Able to work under great physical and mental pressures.

Are you a bilingual professional fluent in Korean and Japanese eager to shape the future of AI? Large-scale language models are transforming the way we learn, work, and communicate—enabling cross-cultural understanding and more natural multilingual interactions. With high-quality training data, tomorrow’s AI can deliver more accurate, reliable, and culturally aware communication across languages and contexts. That training data begins with you—your expertise will help power the next generation of AI.

You’ll work with cutting-edge AI tools, evaluate translations and conversations between Korean and Japanese, and provide structured feedback to improve accuracy, fluency, and cultural alignment.

On a typical day, you will review AI-generated translations, annotate errors, assess responses for naturalness and context, and collaborate with our team to refine prompts, evaluation methods, and linguistic guidelines. Tasks may include verifying terminology, testing conversational flow, and ensuring accurate rendering of idiomatic expressions and domain-specific language.

Fluency in both Korean and Japanese is required, with strong reading, writing, and communication skills in each. Experience in translation, interpretation, localization, or linguistics is a strong plus. Attention to detail and the ability to explain linguistic or cultural nuances clearly are essential.

Ready to channel your bilingual expertise into building the AI tools of tomorrow? Apply today and help train the model that will support multilingual communication for millions worldwide.

We offer a pay range of $8 to $65 per hour, with the exact rate determined after evaluating your experience, expertise, and geographic location. As a contractor you’ll supply a secure computer and reliable internet connection; company-sponsored benefits such as health insurance and PTO do not apply.

About the job

Our Mission Critical Facilities (MCF) team is internationally recognised for delivering high-performance, resilient and sustainable data centre solutions for hyperscale, colocation and enterprise clients.

As Southeast Asia continues to experience rapid digital infrastructure growth, we are strengthening our regional MCF leadership capability and are seeking an experienced Senior Controls Engineer to drive technical excellence and delivery performance across major developments in APAC.

The role is open to candidates based in either Ho Chi Minh City or Jakarta. Given the regional nature of the position, periodic travel between both locations will be expected.

What will you do

As a Senior Controls Engineer, you will lead the design and delivery of Building Management Systems (BMS) and Power Management Systems (PMS) for mission‑critical data centre projects. You’ll work with multidisciplinary teams, develop technical solutions, and ensure all designs meet industry standards and client requirements across both greenfield and brownfield projects.

Key Responsibilities


Lead development of the Controls Philosophy and overall control system design.
Produce complete Controls design packages for global projects.
Conduct condition surveys on existing control systems and instrumentation.
Prepare reports outlining legislative non‑compliance and improvement actions.
Determine optimal design approaches balancing technical and commercial factors.
Support system architecture development for greenfield and brownfield C&I upgrades.
Create Control System designs from concept to detailed design, including performance specifications.
Produce design deliverables—drawings, schedules, datasheets.
Coordinate Control Systems scope with other engineering disciplines.
Collaborate with Revit Technicians and oversee development of 3D Revit models.
Coordinate network infrastructure requirements with Network Infrastructure Engineers.
Prepare and review tender documents, specifications, and BOQs.
Support construction and commissioning phases, including reviewing submittals, responding to queries, and conducting site visits.
Participate in testing and commissioning, up to Integrated Systems Testing.


Where you will work

At Haskoning, you will join an independent, employee-owned international consultancy that combines engineering, design, and consultancy services with software and technology. Our mission, "Enhancing Society Together," drives us to create a positive impact on the world.

We offer purpose-driven and challenging work in diverse international projects, leveraging our 140+ years of expertise. With over 6,800 employees in more than 25 countries, we work together to turn challenges into opportunities and make a real impact on society. We collaborate with leading clients in markets such as infrastructure, climate resilience, renewable energy, decarbonisation of industry, and sustainable mobility.

What you bring

Must‑Have Qualifications:


Bachelor’s or Master’s in Process Automation, Mechatronics, Systems Design Engineering, or equivalent experience. 
Consulting experience in data centres or similar industries. 
5+ years as a Controls Engineer in an MCF environment, ideally data centres. 
Strong HVAC process automation knowledge. 
Experience with SCADA, BMS/PMS/DCIM systems and emerging tech (AI, ML). 
Familiarity with ISO 22237, EN 50600, and related legislation. 
Proficient with Autodesk tools (viewing/mark‑ups). 
Excellent English communication skills. 
Strong organizational, analytical, and time‑management abilities. 
Able to work independently and travel as needed. 


Preferred:


Knowledge of NOCs, SOCs, and site radio systems. 


What we offer you

Within our company you will be able to develop yourself while working on challenging projects in Indonesia, Vietnam and worldwide. Besides that, we also offer you:


Competitive regional compensation package
Private health insurance for you and your family
Accident insurance for employees
Opportunities to lead major hyperscale and colocation data centre projects
Integration into a globally recognised Mission Critical Facilities (MCF) team
Exposure to international clients and cross‑border collaboration
A clear leadership pathway within a fast‑growing APAC platform
Flexible working arrangements
Extensive training and lifelong learning opportunities


Are you our new colleague?

We would like to meet you! Click on the apply button and upload your resume and motivation letter. After receiving your application, we will contact you as soon as possible.

For more information, please feel free to reach out to the hiring team:


Hiring Manager: Mizan Ali – mizan.ali@haskoning.com 
Recruiter (Vietnam): Tram Phan – tram.ngoc.bao.phan@haskoning.com 
Recruiter (Indonesia): Ni Ketut Yusiarini – ni.ketut.yusiarini@haskoning.com 


At Haskoning, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered. Our mission of "Enhancing Society Together" drives us to create an environment that embraces each individual’s unique background, identity, and perspective. Regardless of your experience, background, age, gender, or other personal characteristics—you are welcome here. We believe that diversity makes us stronger and that an inclusive culture gives everyone the opportunity to grow and contribute. Read more about our ED&I initiatives on our dedicated webpage.
